description: Full machine screening, NOT sentence-by-sentence editorial approval. Translation length anomalies are candidate flags, not proof of mistranslation. Quiz semantic review required for all items without explicit source citations.

books.name: 明天，別來學校
books.hook: 明天的自己傳來警告，你敢照常去學校嗎？
books.description: 明天傳來的訊息、突然消失的同學，還有一場全校都參加的匿名投票。米雅越靠近真相，越發現自己也曾是秘密的一部分。

beginning.openingEnglish: At ten past ten on Monday night, my phone showed me a new message. The name above it was Mia Chen. My name. The small picture was also mine: me at the beach, with one eye closed against the sun. I had not sent myself anything. A moment before, I had been trying to learn twelve English words. I knew three. I was bored. Now I could not look away from the screen.
beginning.openingChinese: 星期一晚上十點十分，手機跳出一則新訊息。上面的名字是 Mia Chen——我的名字。小照片也是我：海邊的我，因為陽光而閉著一隻眼睛。我沒有傳東西給自己。就在剛才，我還在試著背十二個英文單字，只會其中三個，無聊得要命。現在，我的目光卻離不開螢幕。
beginning.closingEnglish: My mother knocked and came in with warm milk. She asked if I had finished studying. I said almost. When she left, I opened June's old chat. My last message was still there: Is it true? She had never answered. I wrote, Are you okay? Then I erased it. Outside, rain tapped the glass. My phone lit up one more time. This time, there were only three words. You voted too.
beginning.closingChinese: 媽媽敲門，端著熱牛奶進來，問我讀完了沒。我說快了。她離開後，我打開與 June 的舊對話。最後一則訊息還在：是真的嗎？她從來沒回。我打下「妳還好嗎」，又刪掉。窗外雨滴輕敲玻璃。手機再次亮起，這次只有三個英文單字：妳也投了票。

middle.openingEnglish: June was eating a cheese sandwich when I saw her. I had imagined tears, maybe a long silence, maybe her walking away before I could speak. I had not imagined a sandwich. She looked up, covered her mouth to finish chewing, and pointed at the chair across from her. Her hair was shorter. There was a small spot of yellow paint on her left sleeve.
middle.openingChinese: 我看見 June 時，她正在吃起司三明治。我想過眼淚、長久沉默、她在我開口前離開，沒想過三明治。她抬頭，摀嘴嚼完，指向對面椅子。頭髮變短了，左袖有一小點黃色顏料。
middle.closingEnglish: I wanted to argue. I wanted to hug her. Instead I asked whether she had sent the photo of my handwriting. She nodded. Bell had sent it to her as a threat against me. She had forwarded it without explaining, hoping I would finally understand how easy a cut could be. “I'm sorry for that too,” she said. Then she placed a small memory card between us. “This part isn't a trick.”
middle.closingChinese: 我想爭辯，也想抱她，最後只問字跡照片是否她寄的。她點頭。Bell 拿照片威脅她，說要對付我；她沒解釋就轉寄，希望我終於明白剪掉一部分有多容易。「那件事我也道歉。」她把小記憶卡放在我們中間。「但這個不是騙局。」

ending.openingEnglish: One month later, my phone lit up at ten past ten. The name above the message was Mia Chen. My name. The small picture was still the beach photo with one eye closed. For a moment, my heart moved faster. Then I read the first line of the letter I had really written. Did you listen when the answer was not the one you wanted?
ending.openingChinese: 一個月後，手機在十點十分亮起。名字是 Mia Chen，我的名字；照片還是海邊閉一隻眼的我。有瞬間心跳加快，接著我讀到自己真正寫的第一句：當答案不是妳想要的，妳有聽嗎？
ending.closingEnglish: A real-time message arrived from June. Our teacher wants another short film. Are you free tomorrow? I smiled at the screen. Yes, I wrote. What is it about? Her answer came quickly. A girl keeps getting messages from herself. I stared, then another line appeared. I'm joking. It's about a cat that won't leave a box. Bring a light. Outside, rain touched the glass. I put my phone beside my book and learned one more word before bed.
ending.closingChinese: June 的即時訊息到了：老師要另一部短片，明天有空嗎？我對螢幕笑，回有，拍什麼？她很快答：一個女孩不停收到自己傳的訊息。我愣住，下一行又到：開玩笑，是不肯離開箱子的貓。帶燈來。窗外雨碰玻璃。我把手機放課本旁，睡前再學一個字。

books.name: 雨來之前的鐘聲
books.hook: 晴天響起的警鐘，究竟在警告誰？
books.description: 一聲在晴天響起的警鐘，帶出河屋、工廠與十二年前的祕密。四名朋友必須在暴雨前找出保護小鎮的方法。

beginning.openingEnglish: At 6:10 a.m., the old warning bell rang above the locked River House. Mia Lin stopped so quickly that a box of breakfast food almost fell from her arms. There had been no rain for days. Why did the bell sound as if the river were rising? The street was empty. Beside Mia, Ruby Chen held a cake in one hand and a bag of fruit in the other. “Did you hear that?” Ruby asked. “Everyone heard that,” Mia said. But no one came to the windows. The sound came again: three slow beats. Then it stopped. The early sun lit the roof, and the whole house became quiet.
beginning.openingChinese: 上午六點十分，已上鎖的河屋上方響起老舊的警鐘。米婭·林猛然停步，手裡的一盒早餐差點掉下來。好幾天都沒有下雨。為什麼警鐘卻像河水正在上漲般響著？街上空無一人。身旁的露比·陳一手拿著蛋糕，另一手提著水果。「妳聽見了嗎？」露比問。「大家都聽見了吧。」米婭說。可是，沒有一個人來到窗邊。鐘聲再次響起：緩慢的三下。接著停住。清晨的陽光照亮屋頂，整間屋子恢復安靜。
beginning.closingEnglish: y.” Leo pointed to a thin line under the door. The dark mark Mia had seen was still there, and a small drop of water moved slowly across the ground. “Water has been here recently,” he said. “That much is real.” They did not touch the door. Instead, Mia wrote the date, the time, and what each friend had noticed. As they turned to leave, something knocked once from inside the empty house. It was not the bell. It came from below the floor.
beginning.closingChinese: 午後溫暖，河屋靜悄悄地站著。杰想對著窗戶喊「有鬼！」開個玩笑，卻被露比阻止。「我不想讓奶奶擔心。」李奧指著門下的一條細線。米婭早上看到的深色痕跡還在，一小滴水正慢慢流過地面。「最近這裡真的有水，」他說，「這點可以確定。」他們沒有碰門，而是由米婭記下日期、時間和每個朋友看到的事。轉身準備離開時，空屋裡忽然傳出一下敲擊聲。那不是鐘聲，而是從地板下傳來的。

middle.openingEnglish: Mia went to the city records room with her father and Officer Su. She had never been there before, though the city was only a short train ride away. “What is the age of this building?” she asked while they waited outside. “More than a hundred years,” her father said. “People have used it for records for a long time.” Mia felt small beside the high stone gate. It was difficult to imagine so many years of paper waiting behind one door. Leo and Ruby were at school; everyone had agreed that too many visitors might slow the search. Mia promised to call as soon as she learned anything.
middle.openingChinese: 米婭和父親、蘇小姐一起去市區檔案室。雖然搭火車不遠，她從沒去過。「這棟建築的屋齡是多少？」他們在外頭等候時，她問。「超過一百年，」父親說，「人們很久以前就用它存檔了。」高大的石門讓米婭感覺自己很渺小。她很難想像那麼多年留下的紙都藏在同一扇門後。李奧和露比留在學校；大家都同意訪客太多可能拖慢查詢。米婭答應一有發現就打電話。
middle.closingEnglish: elow the tracks and thought about promises. Her father took a small rock from his pocket, smooth and gray. “Your grandfather gave me this before my first day at work,” he said. “He told me to remember that one small thing can change a large road.” He put the stone in her hand. “Tomorrow we should show the copy to the town and the factory.” Mia nodded. But one question stayed with her: why had nobody checked that the gate was open again?
middle.closingChinese: 他們在職員協助下影印，傍晚前離開市區。火車上，米婭好一陣子沒有再問問題。她看著鐵軌下遠遠的河流，想著承諾。父親從口袋拿出一顆平滑的灰石頭。「這是妳爺爺在我第一天上班前送的，」他說，「他要我記得，一件小事也可能改變一條大路。」他把石頭放進米婭手中。「明天該把副本給公所和工廠看。」米婭點頭。但她心裡仍有一個問題：為什麼從沒有人再確認閘門已經打開？

ending.openingEnglish: When the rain finally stopped, the town was tired, dirty, and still standing. The north gate was open, and the old water path was carrying water away from the houses. There had been damage near the lower road, but the school was safe and every person on the list had been found. Mia saw Officer Su in the town square and asked what would happen now. “First we check the roads and the buildings,” the officer said. “Then we make a new plan that people can trust.” Mia was glad no one called it a miracle. Many people had worked hard to make the ending possible. One man alone could never have done it.
ending.openingChinese: 雨終於停了，整座小鎮疲憊、髒亂，卻還好好站著。北閘門已經打開，舊水路正把水從住家旁引走。低處道路受了損，但學校安全，名單上的每個人也都找到了。米婭在廣場遇見蘇小姐，問接下來會怎樣。「先檢查道路和建築，」蘇小姐說，「再做一份大家可以信任的新計畫。」米婭很高興沒有人把這稱為奇蹟。是許多人努力工作，才讓這個結局成為可能，單靠一個男人絕對辦不到。
ending.closingEnglish: s.” Her father looked at the open water path. “And now?” “Now I know a town is made of many choices. Some were wrong. Some were brave. We have to remember both.” Her father put his hand over hers. The river moved past the stones without hiding under the road. Mia opened her notebook to a fresh page. She wrote a new title: What We Will Check Before the Next Rain. Then she began a list, and this time she knew she would not write it alone.
ending.closingChinese: 婭和父親坐在河邊。「第一次聽到鐘聲時，我想找一個人來責怪，」她說，「後來，我又想找一個人來救我們。」父親望著敞開的水路：「現在呢？」「現在我知道，一座小鎮是很多選擇組成的。有些是錯的，有些很勇敢。我們都得記得。」父親的手覆在她手上。河水流過石頭，不再被困在路面底下。米婭翻開筆記本新的一頁，寫下新標題：下次下雨前，我們要檢查什麼。然後她開始列清單。這一次，她知道自己不會獨自書寫。

books.name: 雙河，同心
books.hook: 同一口鐘，為什麼只有他們聽見不同的聲音？
books.description: 兩名少年聽見不同次數的鐘聲，手上的半圓印記指向被封鎖二十年的水道。信任彼此，才能改寫山城的未來。

beginning.openingEnglish: The bell above the underground station rang nine times, although there was no bell in the station. Shen Yu stopped on the final step of the stairs. Hundreds of people moved around him, but nobody else looked up. A cold line of water ran across the dry floor and vanished beneath the wall. Yu had come to Cloud Gate Academy to develop his power, yet he could barely lift a cup with spirit breath. He followed the wet mark instead of the crowd. At the far end of the platform, a boy in a white coat was trying to hold open a closing door for an old man.
beginning.openingChinese: 地下車站上方傳來九聲鐘響，但車站根本沒有鐘。沈雨停在樓梯最後一階。數百人從身邊走過，卻沒有人抬頭。一道冰涼的水痕劃過乾燥的地板，消失在牆下。沈雨來雲門學院，是想修煉靈力，但他連用靈息舉起一只杯子都很吃力。他沒有跟著人群走，而是循著水痕前進。月臺盡頭，一名白衣少年正替一位老人撐住即將關上的車門。
beginning.closingEnglish: mark, also half a circle. They stared at each other. Far under the street, something heavy shifted, and the seesaw moved although neither boy had touched the ground. Across the yard, a narrow crack opened in the dry earth. The teacher came running and ordered everyone away. Yu heard a tenth bell, very deep and very slow. Qi seized his sleeve. “Do not tell them about our marks,” he whispered. “Not until we know who is ringing that bell.”
beginning.closingChinese: 「這道印記從我小時候就在了，」韓祈說，「鐘聲一響就會痛。」沈雨舉起自己的手，掌心也有一道白色半圓印記。兩人互相凝視。街道深處有沉重的東西移動，翹翹板在兩人都沒踩地時搖了起來。廣場另一頭，乾燥的土地裂出細縫。老師奔來，叫所有人退開。沈雨聽見第十聲鐘，既深又慢。韓祈抓住他的袖子。「先不要告訴他們我們的印記，」他低聲說，「至少在查清誰敲鐘之前。」

middle.openingEnglish: The next morning, a sailor arrived at the capital carrying a bottle of water from the lower stream. His motorcycle stood outside Mei's office, covered in soil and rain marks. “The fish have begun to die,” he said. “People say a thief has poured poison into the water.” Mei did not conclude that the story was true. She separated the sample into clean containers and sent it to the university lab. “We need technology and careful tests,” she told Yu. “A scary story may spread faster than evidence, but evidence gives us a way to act.” Qi watched the water turn cloudy in the bottle.
middle.openingChinese: 隔天早晨，一位船員帶著下游小溪的瓶裝水來首都。他的機車停在梅老師辦公室外，車身沾了土和雨痕。「魚開始死了，」他說，「大家說有小偷往水裡倒毒。」梅老師沒有立刻相信。她把水樣分到乾淨容器，送去大學實驗室。「我們需要科技和仔細的測試，」她對沈雨說，「恐怖故事傳得可能比證據快，但證據讓我們知道怎麼做。」韓祈看著瓶中的水逐漸混濁。
middle.closingEnglish: poison poured by a stranger. The mine had to answer questions about its waste. Yu was relieved that they had not accused a thief, yet he felt no joy. The report proved harm but did not explain who had ordered the river changes. Qi held out a hand to help him over the last rocky step. “We found one piece of the truth,” Qi said. “Tomorrow we ask who moved the gate.” At that moment, the northern tower's bell rang though no storm had begun.
middle.closingChinese: 傍晚實驗室送來初步報告。溪水不安全，危險物質符合石粉污染，不是陌生人倒入的毒液。礦場必須回答廢料問題。沈雨慶幸沒有隨便指控小偷，卻高興不起來。報告證明有傷害，仍沒解釋誰下令改水道。韓祈伸手扶他跨過最後一段岩石路。「我們找到了真相的一塊，」韓祈說，「明天問誰移動了閘門。」就在此時，明明沒有暴風雨，北塔的鐘卻響了。

ending.openingEnglish: Three months later, spring had returned to the valley. The old court had completed the first public hearing, and the full case against Luo would continue under the law. He was no longer allowed to control the gates. The principal of Cloud Gate Academy stood among farmers, workers, and students at a ceremony beside the Quiet River. She read a record of the repairs and explained the data collected since the flood. The two rivers now flowed steadily, and clean water had reached farms long absent from the old maps. The judgment about the people responsible would take time, but the safety work was already real.
ending.openingChinese: 三個月後，春天回到山谷。舊法院已完成第一次公開聽證，對羅的完整案件仍將依法進行；他不再能控制水閘。雲門學院校長站在農夫、工人和學生之間，於靜河旁主持典禮。她朗讀修復紀錄，說明洪水後蒐集的資料。兩條河穩定流動，乾淨水已抵達多年不在舊地圖上的農田。責任人的判決還需要時間，但安全工程已是眼前的事實。
ending.closingEnglish: the stone dust, the council's decision, and the two rivers returning home. He did not write that they had saved the world. That would have been a foolish claim. He wrote instead that people had listened to one another before it was too late. Qi read the page and smiled. Far away, the restored bell rang once to mark the hour. It was a clear, ordinary sound. Neither boy was afraid. They kept walking, with a future both of them had chosen.
ending.closingChinese: 走到最後一座橋時，沈雨再度打開筆記本。他寫下隱藏的鐘聲、失竊河盤、石粉、議會決定，以及兩條河如何回家。他沒有寫自己和韓祈拯救了世界，那樣太誇大也太傻。他寫的是人們如何在太遲之前聽見彼此。韓祈讀完，露出微笑。遠處修復的鐘響了一聲，報出時間。那是清楚、平凡的聲音。兩個少年都不再害怕。他們繼續往前，走向兩人自己選擇的未來。

books.name: 最後的花園
books.hook: 離開地球後，地球卻傳來一句：別相信目的地。
books.description: 星際移民船的最後一座花園即將關閉。一封十二分鐘前由地球寄出的訊息，卻說：不要相信目的地。

beginning.openingEnglish: For eighty years the spaceship Aurora had crossed the darkness between stars. Five hundred passengers slept in silver chambers, trusting the ship to find them another home. Seventeen-year-old Lena and her twin brother Noah belonged to the small crew that stayed awake. Their duty was to care for Garden Seven, where vegetables grew under artificial sunlight and a coconut tree stood beside a patch of dry hay. The garden looked peaceful, but every leaf was part of the ship's breathing system. Without these plants, the sleeping passengers would eventually use the last of their clean air.
beginning.openingChinese: 八十年來，太空船「極光號」一直穿越群星之間的黑暗。五百名乘客睡在銀色艙室裡，相信太空船能替他們找到新家。十七歲的莉娜與雙胞胎弟弟諾亞，屬於少數保持清醒的船員。他們負責照顧七號花園，那裡的蔬菜在人造陽光下生長，一棵椰子樹立在乾草旁。花園看似平靜，卻是全船呼吸系統的一部分。沒有這些植物，沉睡的乘客終將耗盡乾淨的空氣。
beginning.closingEnglish: again, but this time it came directly from the box. Its screen showed four words: MESSAGE FROM PLANET EARTH. According to the date below, the message had been sent just twelve minutes earlier. Earth was eighty years behind them, much too distant for ordinary radio. Before Lena could call Noah, another line appeared: DO NOT TRUST THE DESTINATION. The box opened by itself, revealing a small blue ribbon and a recording of a woman's voice.
beginning.closingChinese: 當晚，莉娜獨自回花園道謝，雖然她也覺得對樹說話很傻。椰子樹幹下有一個早上還不存在的金屬盒。哨聲再次響起，這回直接來自盒子。螢幕上寫著：「來自地球的訊息」。日期顯示，訊息竟是十二分鐘前才發送的。地球早已在八十光年航程之外，普通無線電根本不可能這麼快抵達。還沒來得及叫諾亞，另一行字便跳出：「不要相信目的地。」盒子自行打開，裡面是一條藍色緞帶，以及一段女人的錄音。

middle.openingEnglish: Lena held the blue box against the Liberty Room scanner. A recording of Mara's voice played, and the door opened. Inside grew a tiny oak tree, its first bud opening under a warm lamp. Cotton curtains hung along the walls, and a table held dairy products, canned pineapple, and vegetables from a hidden grocery supply. An anxious woman stood beside the tree, a gray scarf wrapped around her shoulders. Her face was older than the holograms, but Lena knew her immediately. “Mom?” she whispered. The woman covered her mouth, then stepped forward and embraced both children without saying a word.
middle.openingChinese: 莉娜把藍色金屬盒貼上自由室掃描器，播放瑪拉的錄音，門便開了。室內長著一棵小橡樹，第一顆嫩芽在暖燈下展開。棉布簾沿牆垂掛，桌上放著乳製品、鳳梨罐頭，以及祕密雜貨供應處送來的蔬菜。一名焦慮的女子站在樹旁，肩上披著灰圍巾。她的臉比全像影像蒼老，但莉娜立刻認出。「媽媽？」她低聲問。女人摀住嘴，走上前，一句話也沒說就緊緊抱住兩個孩子。
middle.closingEnglish: equipment. She gave Lena a key shaped like a leaf and instructed them to meet the leaders of Aurora's schools. “They can speak for the children,” she said. “And the future belongs to children more than to governors.” Noah reached for his mother's sleeve, afraid she would vanish again. Mara touched his cheek. “I'm coming with you this time.” Outside, heavy boots struck the corridor, and the small oak tree trembled in their passing wind.
middle.closingChinese: 每小時警報響起，瑪拉關上外窗板。保全搜索正擴大到全船，這處安全地點恐怕很快也會被破壞得一片混亂。她給莉娜一把葉子形的鑰匙，吩咐孩子們去見太空船學校的領袖。「他們能替孩子發聲，」她說，「未來屬於孩子的程度，遠大於總督。」諾亞抓著母親的袖子，害怕她再次消失。瑪拉摸摸他的臉：「這次我會跟你們一起走。」外頭傳來沉重軍靴聲，小橡樹被掠過的風震得輕顫。

ending.openingEnglish: The seed craft escaped from the Mirror with seconds to spare. Kel guided its tiny shape aboard Aurora, and a medical team rushed to meet the passengers. Lena's hands were burned, Adrian could barely stand, and Mira had a new bruise across her shoulder, but all three were alive. Noah ran toward them so quickly that he nearly knocked over a nurse. Their reunion was interrupted by an urgent broadcast announcing that the ship was finally free of the false route. For the first time in eighty years, no machine could silently decide where the passengers would go. The news brought both joy and fear, because freedom meant
ending.openingChinese: 種子艇在最後幾秒逃出「鏡面」。凱爾引導小艇返回「極光號」，醫療隊急忙迎接。莉娜雙手燙傷，亞德里安幾乎站不起來，米拉肩上又添瘀青，但三人都還活著。諾亞衝過來，差點撞倒護士。團聚被緊急廣播打斷：太空船終於擺脫虛假航線。八十年來第一次，再也沒有機器能暗中決定乘客要去哪裡。消息帶來喜悅也帶來恐懼，因為自由意味著未來不再確定。
ending.closingEnglish: ld grow on their final world. Lena smiled. “I hope so. But its first job is to teach us how to care for each other while we travel.” Outside the window, the stars moved quietly past. Mara and Adrian stood together beside the door, and Noah waved from the path. Lena touched the first green leaf, remembering the whistle that had begun everything. Somewhere ahead a new home might be waiting, but the choice of how to live had already begun.
ending.closingChinese: 莉娜把苔蘚的種子種進一座對所有孩子開放的新花園。一群學生帶著畫作、問題和多到小房間快裝不下的雜物來了。一個男孩問，這座花園會不會在最終的新世界裡長大。莉娜微笑：「希望會。但它的第一項工作，是在我們旅途中教會彼此如何照顧對方。」窗外星星安靜滑過。瑪拉與亞德里安一起站在門邊，諾亞從小徑揮手。莉娜碰了碰第一片綠葉，想起最初那聲哨響。前方也許有新家正等待，但人們已經開始選擇要怎樣生活。

books.name: 雙時代之鐘
books.hook: 相隔五十年的人，能一起找回被抹去的姓名嗎？
books.description: 1895 與 1945 年的臺北被一座銅鐘連在一起。兩個時代的年輕人，開始追索被歷史留白的姓名。

beginning.openingEnglish: Taipei, 1895. The old opera house stood beside a shady street where tea merchants argued over prices. Lin Zhaoyue, seventeen, arrived before sunrise with a broom and a jar of acid used to clean printing plates. Her employer had asked her to sweep the stage, but she preferred the machinery behind it. Above the curtain hung a copper clock, built from gears that did not match. The clockmaker had died before he could explain its unusual design. Some people called it a miracle; others called it a dangerous phenomenon. Zhaoyue called it a question waiting for a better answer.
beginning.openingChinese: 臺北，1895年。 老戲院坐落在一條陰暗的街旁，茶商每天在那裡爭論價格。十七歲的林昭月天未亮就帶著掃帚，以及清潔印刷版用的酸液來上工。老闆要她掃舞臺，她卻更喜歡研究後臺的機械。布幕上方掛著一座由不同齒輪拼成的銅鐘。造鐘師傅過世前來不及解釋它奇特的設計。有人稱它是奇蹟，有人說那是危險的異象；昭月認為它只是尚未解答的問題。
beginning.closingEnglish: began although no musicians were present. The stage lights flashed. The clock gave a single deep note, and the floor beneath Zhaoyue disappeared. For one breath she saw a different theatre with broken windows, strange electric lamps, and a boy in a white shirt reaching toward the very same clock. He seemed equally surprised. The poster in her hand became warm. Then her shoes touched a new floor, and the year outside was no longer 1895.
beginning.closingChinese: 傍晚，她在一張歌劇海報背面讀到銅鐘的使用說明。 最後一行令人費解：「當兩個終點共用同一時辰，逆著光轉動分針。」十一點五十九分，沒有人演奏，音樂卻自行響起。舞臺燈光一閃，銅鐘發出低沉的一聲，昭月腳下的地板消失了。她看見另一間窗戶破碎、裝著奇異電燈的戲院；一名穿白襯衫的少年正向同一座鐘伸手。他看起來也同樣驚訝。手中的海報漸漸發燙。再度踩到地板時，門外已不再是1895年。

middle.openingEnglish: The third path did not open onto a street. It led to a foundation stone beneath the theatre, where three names had been carved long before Zhaoyue was born. A local legend said the stone could fulfill a wish if three generations sang together. Shen Zhong dismissed the magical explanation but admitted that a choir had once been appointed to test the clock. Their voices produced a steady chorus, and the copper responded. The experiment succeeded only because the singers were separated by fifty-year intervals. The discovery had become a memorable triumph for the clockmaker and a miserable burden for the families inv
middle.openingChinese: 第三條路沒有通往街道，而是通往戲院地基的一塊石頭。 石上刻著三個名字，年代遠早於昭月出生。地方傳說說，只要三代人一起唱歌，石頭便能實現願望。沈仲不相信魔法，但承認當年曾指派一個合唱團測試銅鐘。他們以穩定的合唱聲讓金屬共鳴，而實驗之所以成功，是因為歌者分別來自相距五十年的年代。那是鐘匠難忘的勝利，也成了幾個家庭痛苦的負擔。
middle.closingEnglish: ened an opportunity for powerful men to destroy evidence of them. Their most important task was therefore not to defeat time itself, but to keep multiple honest accounts alive. Shen approved a plan to place three copies of the testimony in three different years. The first would be hidden in 1895. The second would be entrusted to someone in 1945. The third would be carried along the unknown path, if Liang could survive one more crossing.
middle.closingChinese: 眾人請以誠摘要整理發現。 他越說，模式越清楚：銅鐘本身沒有製造失蹤者，而是讓有權勢的人得到毀滅證據的機會。最重要的任務不是打敗時間，而是保住多份誠實記述。沈仲同意在三個年份分別留下證詞：第一份藏於1895年，第二份託付給1945年的人，第三份若阿良撐得過下一次穿越，就送往未知通道。

ending.openingEnglish: Morning dew covered the theatre steps in 1895. The copper clock had stopped, but the names it guarded remained. Zhaoyue woke to find Wenbo waiting with breakfast and a letter from Yicheng. It had traveled through the final open passage during the night. The paper was creased, and the ink had spread into an enormous blue stain, yet she recognized his signature. He wrote that his father's shop was no longer threatened by bankruptcy, and that the new public archive had welcomed volunteers, including people with disabilities whose careful work was too often overlooked. Nothing in the letter suggested that the future
ending.openingChinese: 1895年的早晨，露珠覆滿戲院階梯。 銅鐘已停，但它守護的姓名仍在。昭月醒來，看到文博帶早餐和一封以誠的信在等她。信在夜裡經最後一道開啟的通道送來，紙有摺痕，藍色墨水暈開很大一片，但她認得簽名。他寫道，父親的店不再面臨破產，新的公共檔案室接納許多志工，包括那些細心工作卻常被忽略的身心障礙者。信裡沒有說未來已經完美。
ending.closingEnglish: yue's favorite sentence: “A person is more than the record made of them.” Beneath it, he placed his signature, leaving space for hers though he knew she would never stand beside him in that room again. Outside, morning light touched a city still healing. In another year, the same light fell across the hands of a girl preparing to write. Two histories continued, separate and unfinished, connected by the people who had chosen to remember.
ending.closingChinese: 五十年後，以誠把一本空白書放在安靜的銅鐘下，封面寫著《容得下更多人的歷史》。 他在第一頁抄上昭月最喜歡的句子：「一個人，比別人替他做的紀錄更豐富。」下方簽上自己的名字，也為她留空，儘管知道她不會再站在這間房裡。窗外，晨光照著尚未痊癒的城市。另一個年份裡，同樣的光落在正準備寫字的少女手上。兩段歷史繼續向前，分離且尚未寫完，卻被選擇記住的人們連在一起。

books.name: 南河雙時錄
books.hook: 守住糧倉，還是打開河道？一座城正在等答案。
books.description: 古代水門與現代考古相互印證。一座城究竟該守住糧倉，還是打開被統治者封死的河道？

beginning.openingEnglish: In the kingdom of Lan, the city of Nanhe had survived seven wars but feared one river. Each autumn, the Black River rose against its walls. This year, the governor ordered the western floodgate sealed to protect the royal grain store. He called it a wise decision. To Mei, an apprentice mapmaker, it looked like a dangerous attempt to preserve a failing regime at the expense of ordinary families.
beginning.openingChinese: 在虛構的蘭國，南河城熬過七場戰爭，卻始終畏懼一條河。每到秋天，黑河的水便暴漲，拍打城牆。今年，太守下令封死西側水閘，好保住官家的糧倉。他稱這是明智之舉。在製圖學徒梅眼中，這卻像是為了保全岌岌可危的政權，而把平民百姓推向險境。
beginning.closingEnglish: That winter, the city repaired its canals before rebuilding the governor's house. Mei trained young mapmakers, asking each to question orders that endangered lives. On the temple wall she placed her father's old tablet beneath a simple inscription: A city is not saved by high walls alone, but by those willing to open the right gate. Whenever rain fell, Mei remembered the night Nanhe had chosen its people over its ruler.
beginning.closingChinese: 那年冬天，南河城先修復水道，才重建太守府。梅開始教導年輕製圖師，要他們勇於質疑危及人命的命令。她將父親的舊木牘掛在廟牆上，下面刻著一句話：「拯救一座城的，不只是高牆，還有願意打開正確水門的人。」此後每逢落雨，梅總會想起那一夜——南河城選擇了百姓，而非統治者。

middle.openingEnglish:
The Healer's Consent｜英文正文 605 詞｜目標新詞 20 個

When the city ran short of clean water, its healers tried a conversion of abandoned wine jars into safe storage vessels. The idea seemed simple, but finding enough fuel for boiling placed a new burden on the kitchens. One healer reported a deficit of bandages and a growing number of patients with a strange fever syndrome. Mei requested an extension of the supply schedule while the council searched for new wells. The court's commander replied that the request was illegitimate because the city had refused his taxes. Mei read the letter twice, astonished that anyone could p
middle.openingChinese: 城裡乾淨水源告急，醫者便想把廢棄酒罈改造成儲水容器。辦法看似簡單，燒水所需的燃料卻加重公廚負擔。一名醫者報告繃帶短缺，奇怪的熱病症候群患者越來越多。梅要求延長補給時程，議會同時尋找新水井。王軍將領回信說南河拒稅，請求便不合法。梅把信讀了兩遍，驚訝竟有人將面子置於病童之前。
middle.closingEnglish: . Mei understood that the enemy was trying to make thirst accomplish what swords could not. Rather than conceal the discovery, she asked the healer to explain the risks publicly in a format everyone could understand. The council voted to protect the spring and continue treating prisoners who arrived ill. “We cannot choose which lives deserve water,” Mei said. Her statement was brief, but it became the moral center of the city's defense.
middle.closingChinese: 水流朝城市而來，而不是向外流。有人從另一端封住古泉。梅明白，敵人想讓乾渴完成刀劍做不到的事。她沒有隱瞞，而是請醫者用人人聽得懂的形式公開說明風險。議會表決守住泉水，並繼續治療病重的敵方俘虜。「我們不能決定哪種人有資格喝水。」梅說。話雖短，卻成了南河守城的道德核心。

ending.openingEnglish:
The Gate That Stayed Open｜英文正文 625 詞｜目標新詞 21 個

The final stage of restoration began as the rainy season approached. Forecasters warned of a slow-moving storm whose coverage extended from the northern mountains to the river plain. Engineers checked every pipeline and structural joint along the embankment, while volunteers prepared supplies for shelters. An felt awe standing beside the gate Mei had once saved. Its stone surface was obscure beneath layers of repair, yet the mechanism still worked. The team's main criterion was simple: the city must remain safe even if the new museum exhibition had to close. Beautif
ending.openingChinese: 雨季將近，修復進入最後階段。預報說一場移動緩慢的暴雨將籠罩北山到河原。工程師檢查堤上每條管線與結構接縫，志工準備避難物資。安站在梅曾救過的水門旁，心中滿是敬畏。石面在層層修補下難辨原貌，機關卻仍能動。團隊最重要的判準很簡單：即使新展覽必須關閉，也要先確保城市安全。漂亮展示可以等，活人不行。
ending.closingEnglish: untouched; several homes needed repairs, and families mourned what the water took. Yet there was no disaster on the scale once feared. At the shelter a small choir began to sing, and the sound reached An through an open window. She imagined another morning, centuries earlier, when Mei had stood above the same river. The two women would never meet, yet their work belonged to one story: protecting memory so that memory could protect life.
ending.closingChinese: 清晨河水上漲，第三道水門卻把最凶猛的洪流引往空曠平原。沒有哪個社區完全不受影響；幾間屋子待修，人們也為被水帶走的東西哀傷。但最可怕的災難沒有發生。避難所裡，一小群人組成的合唱團開始唱歌，歌聲穿過開窗傳到安耳邊。她想像數百年前另一個清晨，梅站在同一條河上。兩人永不會見面，所做的事卻屬於同一個故事：保存記憶，好讓記憶繼續守護生命。

books.name: 戀愛嫌疑犯通緝中
books.hook: 拿錯一封情書，怎麼連死對頭都變得可疑？
books.description: 她負責把活動變成事故，他負責把事故排進行程。從一封拿錯的情書開始，兩人一起成為校園戀愛嫌疑犯。

beginning.openingEnglish: Professor Chen called us “a promising comparative experiment.” I called us an insurance claim waiting to happen. At twenty-one, I preferred studying romance from a safe distance, but for our university's Culture Night, she had assigned me to narrate an exhibition called Love Through the Ages. My partner was Eli Wu, the quiet student who managed the history department's archive. Eli could sort centuries-old letters in minutes. I could lose my phone while holding it. Professor Chen looked from him to me and smiled. Apparently, that was exactly the problem she wanted us to solve.
beginning.openingChinese: 陳教授稱我們為「很有前景的比較實驗」；我則認為，我們根本是一場等待發生的保險事故。二十一歲的我一直認為，戀愛這門學問最好保持安全距離來研究。可惜，教授指定我在大學文化之夜，擔任「穿越時代的愛情」展覽旁白。我的搭檔是吳以禮——歷史系檔案室的安靜男生。以禮能在幾分鐘內整理好好幾個世紀前的情書，我卻能在手機拿在手上時把它弄丟。陳教授看看他，再看看我，露出微笑。顯然，這正是她希望我們解決的問題。
beginning.closingEnglish: ust hand me a historical document by mistake?” “No.” “And if I ask you on a date, will you say yes?” Eli's ears turned pink. “That's the answer I've been preparing for three weeks.” I kissed his cheek before my courage could expire. From inside the student center came a crash, followed by June shouting, “WHO PUT A BRA ON THE CHARITY MASCOT?” Eli and I looked at each other. Our first date could wait until we rescued the university again.
beginning.closingChinese: 說，「這不是寫給克拉拉的？」「完全不是。」「你也不是不小心把一份歷史文件交給我？」「不是。」「那如果我約你出去，你會答應嗎？」以禮的耳朵變粉紅色了。「這個答案，我已經準備三個星期了。」趁勇氣還沒耗盡，我親了一下他的臉頰。學生活動中心裡突然傳來一聲巨響，接著是小君的咆哮：「到底是誰把胸罩套在慈善吉祥物頭上？」我和以禮對看了一眼。看來，我們的第一次約會得等到最後一次拯救大學之後了。

middle.zh: 全校運動會的數學情書
middle.openingEnglish: The campus sports festival was already underway when I discovered that Eli had enrolled us in the mixed relay race. “I thought this was a chess tournament,” I protested. He showed me the email, which plainly said ATHLETIC FESTIVAL. My ability to ignore capital letters was becoming a concern. June, our most outgoing friend, announced that she would provide commentary. Clara arrived carrying an enormous suitcase of costumes. She explained that every athlete deserved a dramatic entrance. Our coach, a retired sportswoman, said the only requirement was to arrive at the starting line on time. Apparently, even love coul
middle.openingChinese: 校園運動會已經開始，我才發現以禮替我們報名了男女混合接力。「我以為這是西洋棋比賽，」我抗議。他拿出郵件，上面清清楚楚寫著「體育節」。我忽略大寫字母的能力實在令人擔憂。最外向的小君宣布她要擔任賽評。克拉拉則拖來巨大的行李箱，表示每位運動員都值得戲劇性進場。我們的教練是一位退休女運動員，她說唯一要求就是準時站到起跑線上。看來，即使談戀愛也不能免除基本閱讀能力。
middle.closingEnglish: As we washed the mud from our shoes, I noticed that Eli had shown no indifference toward our teammates, even after the race ended. He remembered who needed water, who had a sore ankle, and who wanted a group photograph. I wondered how many quiet acts of care it took to make a person feel part of a team.
middle.closingChinese: 洗掉鞋上的泥巴時，我發現即使比賽結束，以禮對隊友也毫不冷漠。他記得誰需要水、誰腳踝不舒服、誰想拍團體照。我不禁想，一個人究竟要付出多少安靜的關心，才能讓別人感覺自己屬於一個團隊。

ending.openingEnglish: Graduation morning arrived amid a storm of camera flashes and nervous laughter. The whole campus seemed filled with anticipation. Eli had finished his coursework and was preparing to leave for his semester-long placement. I had an internship of my own at the university museum, where I would begin as an apprentice educator. The dean praised our class for showing backbone during difficult projects. June had been placed in charge of the ceremony's treasury, an act of institutional bravery that truly stunned me. Clara, naturally, had organized a farewell performance. “Nothing dramatic,” she promised, which terrified
ending.openingChinese: 畢業典禮早晨，在閃光燈和緊張笑聲之中到來。整座校園充滿期待。以禮完成課業，即將前往另一座城市展開一學期的實習。我也拿到自己的實習，在大學博物館擔任教育學徒。院長稱讚我們在困難專案中展現骨氣。小君負責典禮財務部門，這種制度性的勇氣讓我非常震驚。克拉拉當然也籌辦告別演出。「絕對不戲劇化，」她保證。所有認識她的人都害怕了。
ending.closingEnglish: acock, and the infamous astronaut octopus. Eli laughed so hard that I thought he might never recover. We posed for one last photograph: four friends, two ridiculous signs, and a future none of us could completely predict. Then he took my hand. Our story hadn't ended with graduation; it had simply reached the page where we would begin writing the next part ourselves. This time, nobody needed a warrant to prove who had stolen whose heart.
ending.closingChinese: 夕陽落到圖書館後方時，小君和克拉拉突然舉著布條出現，上面寫著：「結案：愛情已尋獲。」她們還畫了蘑菇、紙船、巨型孔雀，以及那隻惡名昭彰的太空章魚。以禮笑到我以為他無法恢復。我們拍下最後一張合照：四個朋友、兩塊荒謬牌子，以及誰都無法完全預測的未來。接著他握住我的手。我們的故事沒有因畢業而結束，只是翻到了要親手寫下一頁的地方。這一次，不再需要任何搜查令，就能證明是誰偷走了誰的心。

books.name: 種子帳冊
books.hook: 十一年沒有植物的城外，為什麼長出一顆莓果？
books.description: 玻璃城外十一年沒有植物生長，一顆屋頂上的莓果卻指向母親藏起的種子庫。艾莉絲沿著藍色圓圈，追查被壟斷的雨水。

beginning.openingEnglish: On the morning the last rain tank ran dry, Iris Chen found a red berry growing through the roof of her family's hut. It was impossible. Nothing had grown outside the city's glass walls for eleven years. Even the old heater beside her bed had stopped working, and her little brother Theo wore two coats to breakfast. Beyond the fence, a broken circus tent stood among rusted buses, its painted stars fading into gray. Iris put the berry in her pocket and went there because the tent's lights had flashed three times during the night. Inside she met an elderly magician named Orin, who had once performed tricks for childr
beginning.openingChinese: 最後一座雨水槽乾涸的早晨，艾莉絲・陳在自家小屋屋頂發現一顆紅色莓果。這根本不可能。十一年來，城市玻璃牆外沒有任何植物生長。連床邊的舊暖氣都壞了，弟弟西奧吃早餐時得穿兩件外套。圍牆外，一座殘破的馬戲團帳篷立在生鏽的巴士間，帳篷上的彩繪星星已褪成灰色。艾莉絲把莓果收入口袋，走向帳篷，因為她昨夜看見那裡的燈閃了三次。裡面有位叫奧林的老魔術師，過去曾為孩子表演。一隻機械小精靈盤旋在他肩上，翅膀無聲，雙眼泛綠光。奧林拿出一張地下種子庫的舊地契。「這是妳母親藏的，」他
beginning.closingEnglish: e old magician began a ridiculous performance, loudly claiming that he had turned her into a mouse. For one precious moment the soldiers laughed. Iris crawled onward. At the far end of the tunnel she found a drawing carved into the stone: the same blue circle as on the map. Beneath it were three words her mother had written years before: WHEN WATER RETURNS. Iris touched the marks. Somewhere beyond the walls, a secret garden was waiting.
beginning.closingChinese: 莉絲穿過馬戲團院子，爬進排水隧道。機械精靈跟在身後，發出微弱藍光。背後傳來靴聲，以及軍官命令奧林投降的喊聲。「那女孩在哪裡？」另一名軍官叫道。老魔術師開始荒唐的表演，大聲宣稱自己把她變成了老鼠。士兵們因此笑了一瞬。艾莉絲繼續往前爬。隧道末端，她發現石壁上刻著與地圖相同的藍圈，下面還有母親多年前留下的三個字：「當水回來。」艾莉絲摸著刻痕。圍牆之外的某個地方，有座祕密花園正在等待。

middle.openingEnglish: The next city stood around a marble square where a giant crane lifted barrels of water onto private trucks. An assistant in a clean uniform welcomed the travelers with a polite smile that barely hid her tiredness. She offered them a bitter tea and explained that the company rated every family's usefulness before deciding how much water to sell. The comparison was made by a computer using old employment records, but nobody could inspect its underlying rules. Iris asked whether the system was satisfactory to residents. The assistant hesitated. 'Some people eat well,' she said. 'Most do not.' Across the square a gan
middle.openingChinese: 下一座城市圍繞大理石廣場建造，巨型吊車把一桶桶水吊上私人卡車。一名穿乾淨制服的助理帶著禮貌笑容迎接旅人，卻幾乎掩不住疲憊。她端來苦茶，解釋公司會先評定每戶的「有用程度」，再決定賣多少水。電腦根據舊工作紀錄比較，底層規則卻不開放檢查。艾莉絲問居民對系統是否滿意。助理遲疑了。「有人吃得很好，」她說，「大多數人沒有。」廣場另一側，一群公司守衛盯著人潮。隊長拿著線控木偶，每當貧窮家庭靠近付款桌，就讓木偶鞠躬。艾莉絲不知道這表演是玩笑還是警告。
middle.closingEnglish: oked officer,' Iris said. 'It's a business built around thirst.' The assistant asked whether the travelers could help her leave. She feared what would happen if her employers learned she had shared the records. Iris promised a place on the ferry, and Gar offered a coat to hide her uniform. The assistant looked at them with disbelief. For years every favor had carried a price. She had almost forgotten that kindness could be given freely.
middle.closingChinese: 露木偶表演源於舊管理手冊。手冊教守衛先讓人感到渺小，再要求服從。瑪拉抄下清單，西奧測試城市水表。他們發現計價程式連到同一家聲稱擁有河床的公司。「這不只是一個腐敗軍官，」艾莉絲說，「這是一門圍繞口渴建立的生意。」助理問能否幫她離開。她怕雇主知道她洩露紀錄。艾莉絲答應船上有位置，加爾送她一件大衣遮住制服。助理難以置信地看著眾人。多年來每個人情都有價格，她幾乎忘了善意也可以免費給予。

ending.openingEnglish: One year after the drought began to end, Iris returned to the hill above her old neighborhood. Below her lay a rectangle of green fields where a heap of broken machines had once stood. The community had transformed the former factory grounds into a public center for agriculture, with a school, tool library, and rows of new crops. A small electric cart carried supplies between the fields. Theo had become an efficient repair teacher, showing students how to use a cleaner to remove dust from solar panels. Juno supervised the mechanical workshop while Mara helped prepare educational lessons about the mistakes of the
ending.openingChinese: 乾旱開始結束的一年後，艾莉絲回到舊社區上方的山坡。下面一塊長方形綠田，曾經堆滿破機器。社區把舊工廠地改造成公共農業中心，設有學校、工具圖書館及一排排新作物。小電動推車往返田間載物資。西奧成為有效率的維修教師，教學生用清潔機清除太陽能板灰塵。朱諾負責機械工坊，瑪拉協助準備教育課程，教人理解過去犯過的錯。艾莉絲望著田微笑。綠意並不完美，有些植物仍很艱難，也有地方受損太深無法種植。但每塊地都有名字、有計畫，也有人願意照顧。
ending.closingEnglish: ild agreed with great seriousness. Iris looked over the fields toward the distant mountains where the river began. She remembered the circus tent, the old magician, the train, the dam, and all the hands that had helped along the way. The world was not healed, and there would be new mistakes. But the land was no longer silent. Somewhere a child laughed, water flowed through a pipe, and the first green rectangle waited to become a forest.
ending.closingChinese: 子推小車穿梭田間，學蔬菜名字與好土壤的重要。艾莉絲給他們看旅途中一路帶著的紅莓果種子，它終於在學校菜園長成小植物。她請學生替它澆水，孩子非常認真地答應。艾莉絲越過田地望向遠方山脈，河流就從那裡開始。她記得馬戲團帳篷、老魔術師、列車、大壩，以及一路伸出援手的雙手。世界尚未完全治癒，也還會有新錯誤，但大地不再沉默。某處孩子在笑，水沿管線流動，而第一塊綠色長方形，正等待長成一座森林。

books.name: 第七盞燈
books.hook: 官方只有六盞燈，照片裡的第七盞從何而來？
books.description: 島上只有六道官方燈光，匿名照片卻拍到第七盞。攝影師黎雅在災變前追查照片，發現真正的問題是誰一直移動第六盞燈。

beginning.openingEnglish: Lia Chen arrived over Morrow Island at dawn, strapped into a small rescue aircraft. The pilot said the storm was too fierce for landing and offered a parachute instead, as if that were a reasonable choice for a photographer who considered climbing stairs a workout. Far below lay a cottage, a broken pier, and six lighthouse lamps. Yet the visual reference sent to Lia by an unknown witness showed seven. She had come to give a presentation about coastal diversity, but now she possessed a question much more urgent than the conference. The island council had called the missing light a harmless legend. Someone had writ
beginning.openingChinese: 黎雅・陳在黎明島上空迎接清晨，身上繫著小型救援飛機的安全帶。機師說風暴太猛烈，無法降落，竟提議她改用降落傘，彷彿一個把爬樓梯當健身的攝影師會覺得這很合理。下方有小屋、毀損的碼頭與六盞燈塔燈，可是匿名證人寄給她的照片卻拍到七盞。她原本是來做海岸生物多樣性簡報的，如今卻多了一個更急迫的問題。島議會把第七盞燈說成無害傳說，照片背面卻有人用紅字寫著「違規」。黎雅把照片貼在舷窗上，試圖向機師說清楚那些奇怪的幾何線條。
beginning.closingEnglish: he same as surrender, and that an accusation required proof. She agreed with him. Rather than post the photograph immediately, she placed three copies in separate envelopes, recorded Rosa's words, and charged every battery she owned. Outside, the six official lights swept the black water. A seventh flash appeared between two waves and vanished. This time the camera caught it, and the faint silhouette beside it looked unmistakably human.
beginning.closingChinese: 後，大會主辦方傳訊請黎雅不要提那張照片。只要她願意談談彩色海鳥與可愛漁俗，就有更好的房間、更大的觀眾群與優渥酬勞。黎雅讀了兩次。她的編輯常說，克制不等於投降，指控需要證據；她也同意。因此她沒有立即公開照片，而是分別封存三份副本，錄下蘿莎的說法，並充飽所有電池。窗外六盞官方燈光掃過黑海。忽然，第七道光在兩道浪之間閃現，又瞬間消失。這次相機拍到了，而且光旁淡淡的人影清晰得令人心驚。

middle.openingEnglish: Mira's next calculation focused on the blue crystals from the warehouse cloth. In a spare classroom she arranged samples in a glass cube, added seawater, and showed how a magnetic residue formed around the edges. The explanation was technical, yet the implication was simple: the substance had traveled through the same channels as drinking water. Hana linked the residue to a rare marine species living near geothermal vents, while Elena discovered that a gene study funded by Helix Tide had quietly vanished from the public library. Someone had known the obstacle for months and chosen silence over repair.
middle.openingChinese: 米拉下一步的計算，鎖定在倉庫布料上的藍色結晶。她在一間空教室裡，把樣本放進玻璃方塊中，注入海水，展示邊緣如何形成帶磁性的殘留層。原理解釋雖然技術性十足，含義卻非常簡單：那種物質已沿著與飲用水相同的通道移動。哈娜教授則把殘留物和一種生長在地熱口附近的稀有海洋物種連了起來；艾蓮娜更發現，一份由海潮螺旋資助的基因研究早已從公共圖書館悄悄消失。有人數月前就知道障礙所在，卻選擇沉默，而非修補。
middle.closingEnglish: a ditch. Lia caught his arm. He laughed weakly, more from exhaustion than humor. “I used to think contentment meant staying out of trouble,” he said. “Now I think it means being able to sleep without lying to myself.” Lia did not answer at once. The sea was dark, the wind tolerant of no delay, and the seventh light flickered once on the horizon. Even so, for a brief moment, both of them felt a strange steadiness settle in their chests.
middle.closingChinese: 回程路上，托瑪斯在懸崖小徑上踩空，差點翻進水溝，幸好被黎雅一把拉住。他虛弱地笑了笑，疲憊遠多於幽默。「我以前以為滿足就是少惹麻煩，」他說，「現在覺得，滿足是能在晚上不對自己說謊地睡著。」黎雅沒有立刻回答。海很暗，風也不容拖延，第七盞燈在地平線上短短閃了一次。即便如此，兩人胸口仍在那一刻落下一種奇異的穩定感。

ending.openingEnglish: The hearing lasted all day. On one panel sat engineers, judges, and a regional finance officer; on another sat island witnesses, including Rosa, Tomas, Elena, Mira, and even Mara. Lia's publication archive, the electronics recovered from the cliff, and the founder's letter together formed an unbroken chain. The company argued that concerning procedures had indeed been imperfect but denied criminal intent. Then Lewis presented the hidden contracts, and the defense broke. The millionaire admitted he had imposed deadlines that made safety impossible. Gavin, pale and sweating, was found guilty of document tampering a
ending.openingChinese: 聽證持續了一整天。一側評議席坐著工程師、法官與區域財務官；另一側則坐著島上證人，包括蘿莎、托瑪斯、艾蓮娜、米拉，甚至瑪拉。黎雅保存的報導資料、從懸崖內找到的電子設備，以及創辦人留下的信，最終串成一條無可切斷的證據鏈。公司起初辯稱流程確實有瑕疵，但否認具有犯罪意圖。直到路易斯攤出那批隱藏契約，整道防線才真正崩解。百萬富豪承認，是自己強加了不可能兼顧安全的期限；蓋文則因篡改文件與妨礙調查，被認定有罪。市長在日落前辭職。
ending.closingEnglish: mera. Some moments belonged in the public record, and some needed to be lived before anyone tried to describe them. Behind them, Niko argued cheerfully with a volunteer about where to plant the remaining herbs. His arm was healing. Across the water, the six lights continued their ordinary work. The seventh had given them a story, but the island's next chapter would be made in daylight, through decisions small enough for everyone to see.
ending.closingChinese: 之後托瑪斯去港口，發現艾蓮娜正看補給船離開。公司的敗訴沒有讓父親的問題消失。他們同意繼續尋找，請區域調查員檢查密碼本裡的航線。黎雅從廚房帶來三個杯子，沒有舉相機。有些時刻屬於公共紀錄，有些要先親自活過，才適合描述。身後尼可開心地與志工爭論剩下的香草種在哪；他的手臂正在復原。水面上，六盞燈繼續平凡工作。第七道光給了他們故事，但島的下一章將在白晝寫下，由每個人都看得見的小決定完成。

books.name: 雲岬十三光
books.hook: 父親留下的燈塔，照見的是歸途，還是秘密？
books.description: 林雨回到父親遺留的燈塔，先看見一整圈死去的珊瑚。十三道光、家族祕密與海底電纜，逐步連成不能再沉默的真相。

beginning.openingEnglish: When marine archivist Lin Yu returned to Yun Cape Island, she expected an argument over her father's abandoned lighthouse, not an immense ring of dead coral. The white branches lay under clear water like the bones of an ancient city. Beside the harbor chapel, fishing families formed a cluster around a notice promising compensation for damaged nets. The notice said nothing about the reef. Yu had spent ten years in a metropolitan laboratory, where problems arrived as numbers on screens. Here each number had a face: a child who could no longer swim, a fisherman afraid to take his boat out, a mother watching the tide
beginning.openingChinese: 海洋檔案研究員林雨回到雲岬島時，以為等著她的只是父親遺留燈塔的產權爭執，沒想到先看見大片死去的珊瑚。潔白的枝椏躺在清澈海水裡，像古城的骸骨。港邊小教堂旁，一群漁家圍著賠償告示，政府承諾補償受損漁網，卻隻字不提礁群。林雨在大都會的實驗室待了十年，習慣把問題化為螢幕上的數字；但在故鄉，每個數字都是一張真實的臉：不能再下海的孩子、不敢出航的漁夫，以及望著潮汐發愁的母親。
beginning.closingEnglish: disappearance had not been an accident. But she also knew how easily grief could transform coincidences into a story. She copied the measurements into her notebook, photographed the footprint, and locked the door behind them. Tomorrow she would visit the reef herself. Tonight she sat on the hillside watching the harbor lights flicker one by one. Far offshore, a thirteenth light blinked twice, paused, and then disappeared into the mist.
beginning.closingChinese: 林雨沒有立刻把信告訴阿博。她需要分辨恐懼與真正的洞察。若父親發現海灣下的祕密，他的失蹤也許不是意外；但悲傷也可能讓人把巧合拼成故事。她把數據抄進筆記本，拍下腳印，再鎖好門。明天，她要親自下海查看珊瑚。今夜，她坐在山坡上，看港口燈火一盞盞閃動。遙遠外海，第十三道燈光閃了兩次，停了停，便消失在霧中。

middle.openingEnglish: The clinic reported an acute illness among technicians who had entered the tunnel, but doctors could not yet say whether it was contagious. The hospital administrator arranged separate rooms until the cause could be studied. Some families accused her of bias because company managers received private treatment. She acknowledged the unequal conditions and promised to publish the allocation of medical resources. Rae began filming a documentary about how different kinds of evidence were gathered. She avoided showing patients' faces without permission. Yu helped measure the tunnel's length, width, and depth, writing e
middle.openingChinese: 診所通報進入隧道的技術員出現急性病症，醫師尚無法判斷是否具傳染性。醫院行政主管先安排分房觀察，部分家庭卻指責她偏袒接受私人治療的公司主管。她承認條件不平等，答應公開醫療資源分配。蕾開始拍攝紀錄片，說明不同證據如何取得；未經同意，她不拍攝病人面孔。林雨協助測量隧道長寬深，把每個尺寸寫下，供第二組人員複核。
middle.closingEnglish: n dangerous if calculations were wrong. She decided to request an independent inspection before moving any gate. Her father had once believed he could protect everyone by working secretly with one brilliant inventor. Now she understood the weakness of that approach. A safety system known only to a few people was easy to capture, neglect, or erase. This time, the map would be copied into the public archive before any machine was touched.
middle.closingChinese: 林雨從燈塔屋頂看遠處工人在水庫旁架臨時護欄。最脆弱的住區位於下坡，計算若有差錯就十分危險。她決定在動任何水門前要求獨立檢查。父親曾以為與一位天才發明家私下合作便能守護所有人，如今她看見這方法的弱點：只有少數人知道的安全系統，很容易被奪走、忽略或抹去。這一次，在碰機器前，她要先把地圖存入公開檔案。

ending.openingEnglish: One year later Yu walked alongside the new public canal, where fresh water moved gently toward the recovering bay. The town had learned to alternate periods of repair with periods of observation, allowing scientists to measure each change before making another. The most crucial lesson was not that one machine had been evil and another good. It was that systems must evolve as people discover their mistakes. Yu held the railing in a firm grip and watched a child release a floating wooden boat. The little craft followed the current without touching the newly planted coral, whose color was slowly returning beneath th
ending.openingChinese: 一年後，林雨沿著新建的公共水渠散步，淡水柔和流向逐漸復原的海灣。鎮上學會交替進行修繕與觀察，每做一次改變就先讓科學家測量，再決定下一步。最重要的教訓並不是某台機器邪惡、另一台良善，而是制度必須隨人們發現錯誤而進化。林雨緊握欄杆，看孩子放下一艘木玩具船，小船順流而行，沒有碰到新植珊瑚。清澈水下，珊瑚色彩正慢慢回來。
ending.closingEnglish: rchive for the night, then placed its key in a cabinet accessible to the morning staff. Rae prepared tomorrow's report; Ivo checked the last water readings; Mina walked home with her brother. The island's work continued in ordinary hands. Yu looked toward the reef and imagined what it might look like after another twenty years of patient care. The future was uncertain, but for once uncertainty felt like a beginning rather than a threat.
ending.closingChinese: 人群離開後，林雨獨自爬上燈塔。第十三盞燈不再屬於私人控制系統，而是穩穩照向水道，讓水手不靠祕密知識也能辨認。樓下，阿博關上公共檔案室，把鑰匙放進早班人員可拿到的櫃子。蕾準備明日報導，伊沃檢查最後水質讀值，米娜陪哥哥回家。小島的工作留在平凡人手裡繼續。林雨望向礁群，想像二十年耐心照料後的模樣。未來仍不確定，但這一次，不確定終於更像開始，而非威脅。

books.name: 第十三站台
books.hook: 列車叫出妳的全名時，千萬別回答。
books.description: 未曾買過的黑色車票出現在見夏手中。失蹤哥哥的訊息說：列車若叫妳的名字，千萬別回答。黑暗中的廣播，卻已經叫出她的全名。

beginning.openingEnglish: At 12:43 a.m., Lin Jianxia was standing beneath a broken departure board when a black ticket appeared between her fingers. She had not bought it. She tried to loosen her clasp, but the ticket seemed to hold her hand instead. Platform 13 was printed in silver beneath the words ONE WAY. No such platform existed in the university district. When a distant bell rang, the pigeons outside the station suddenly rose in a noisy cloud, and a sound like horses at a gallop passed through the sealed tunnel. Jianxia thought of leaving. Then the final message from her missing older brother lit her phone: If a train calls your na
beginning.openingChinese: 凌晨十二點四十三分，林見夏站在故障的發車看板下，手指間突然多了一張黑色車票。她根本沒買票，試著鬆開緊握的手，車票卻像反過來抓住她。票上以銀字印著「第十三站台」和「單程」。大學區根本沒有這個月台。遠處鐘聲響起，站外的鴿子猛然飛起，封閉的隧道裡傳來萬馬奔騰般的聲響。她正想離開，手機亮出失蹤哥哥留下的最後訊息：「如果列車叫你的名字，不要回答。」黑暗裡卻傳來女人的聲音：「林見夏，請上車。」
beginning.closingEnglish: e breath and stepped aboard, choosing the seat nearest the emergency handle. The old woman thanked her for making room. Shen Man checked everyone's pulse, perhaps because it was the only normal thing left to do. The train departed, and the station disappeared behind a curtain of white light. Across from Jianxia, an empty seat slowly developed the shape of someone sitting in it. The announcement began: “Welcome back, passenger thirteen.”
beginning.closingChinese: 低沉的聲音邀請眾人上車。見夏原本還想問最後一個問題，鐘聲卻吞掉她的話。周硯站在門邊，沒有催促。「妳可以留下，」他說，「但我不能保證那樣更安全。」整晚只有他說清這個差別。見夏深呼吸，上車後選了靠近緊急拉柄的位置。老婦人謝她讓位，沈漫替大家量脈搏，或許只是想做一件還算正常的事。列車啟動，車站消失在白光後。她對面的空椅子慢慢凹陷，像有人正在坐下。廣播響起：「歡迎歸來，第十三號乘客。」

middle.openingEnglish: The next train arrived with its shutters closed. Inside, wooden benches formed a courtroom, and the passengers were told to decide which traveler would be left behind. A clock increased its tempo whenever someone raised a hand. Above the judge's chair hung cosmetics advertisements and a portrait of a stylish woman smiling beside a jar of crackers. He Chuan called the scene a terrible attempt at glamour. Jianxia noticed an electrician repairing cables under the bench, apparently oblivious to the trial. When she approached him, he whispered that every vote altered the station's power supply. The judge wanted more t
middle.openingChinese: 下一班車的遮板全數關閉，車內木椅排成法庭，乘客被迫投票決定誰留下。有人舉手，時鐘的節奏就變快。法官椅上方掛著化妝品廣告，一名時髦女人微笑站在餅乾罐旁。賀川說這是糟糕的華麗舞台。見夏注意到有電工在座椅下修線，似乎不理會審判。她靠近時，電工悄聲說每張票都會改變車站電源。法官要的不是單一受害者，而是乘客選擇哪些記憶可以繼續存在。
middle.closingEnglish: ourtroom benches folded into ordinary train seats, and the windows showed a platform drenched in red rain. Zhou Yan held Jianxia's hand as the doors opened. “If the system can force a vote,” he said, “it can probably force a memory too.” Jianxia thought of the woman whose eyelash had been left on the judge's desk. Somewhere, somebody had once been this frightened child. She wanted to find them before the machine erased their last trace.
middle.closingChinese: 孩子垂頭等著因失敗受罰，見夏卻蹲下來說：「你不必審判任何人。」他抬頭，驚訝這句話也能是真的。木椅折成普通列車座，窗外露出被紅雨浸透的月台。周硯牽著見夏的手走向車門。「如果系統能逼人投票，」他說，「多半也能逼人記得某件事。」見夏想起法官桌上的睫毛，某個地方曾有人真的是這個受驚孩子。她想在機器抹去最後痕跡前找到對方。

ending.openingEnglish: The first real train of the morning arrived with a diesel engine that coughed beneath the station roof. Jianxia sat on a bench, her head resting against Zhou Yan's shoulder, almost ready to doze. The world smelled of breakfast rather than burnt wires. Nearby, Shen Man helped a child with asthma use an inhaler while He Chuan collected the names of returning passengers. A printed notice announced bilateral cooperation between the city hospital and a research council to rehabilitate survivors. Its official language was stiff, but Jianxia felt a little goodwill in the volunteers who brought blankets and hot tea. For
ending.openingChinese: 清晨第一班真正的列車進站，柴油引擎在站棚下發出咳嗽般聲音。見夏坐在長椅上，頭靠著周硯肩，幾乎睡著。空氣是早餐味，不再是燒焦電線。附近沈漫幫氣喘孩子使用吸入器，賀川收集歸來者名字。公告宣布市立醫院與研究委員會雙邊合作，協助倖存者復健。官話依舊生硬，但送毛毯和熱茶的志工讓見夏感到善意。許多個夜晚以來，終於沒有人要求乘客為座位付代價。
ending.closingEnglish: through tears. Jianxia turned to Zhou Yan. “Would you like to get breakfast?” she asked. He looked at the platform clock, which now showed an ordinary hour. “Only if we can choose the restaurant.” She laughed. They stepped into the carriage together, neither leading nor following. Through the window, a sign marked Platform 13 flickered once and went dark. The city moved toward morning, and for once the road ahead belonged to no machine.
ending.closingChinese: 車門打開，沈漫在月台揮手，已開始規畫倖存者醫療計畫。賀川舉起相機，承諾未經當事人同意不公開任何故事。老婦人站在女兒旁，含淚微笑。見夏轉向周硯：「要不要去吃早餐？」他看了一眼顯示正常時間的站鐘：「可以，只要餐廳由我們選。」她笑了。兩人一起上車，沒有人領先或跟隨。窗外「第十三站台」牌子短暫閃了一次，便暗了。城市走向早晨，未來的路終於不再屬於任何機器。

books.name: 灰橋不低頭
books.hook: 如果城市被偷偷賣掉，居民能用什麼拿回它？
books.description: 前稽核官沈米拉回到灰橋市，發現水災背後的資產轉移與水網黑箱。她與居民追查紅印帳冊，以證據奪回城市的決定權。

beginning.openingEnglish: No official could offer certainty inside the flooded chapel. A cluster of families demanded compensation, while Mira asked the clerk to disclose the order that had shut their street gate. The morning bells sounded far away from the East Ward chapel. A delivery cart rattled over broken pavement, and for several minutes the gathering had to wait for the noise to fade. Mira used the interruption to count exits, check which doors could be opened from the inside, and see whether anyone needed a chair. Her years in the audit office had taught her that important failures often hid among things considered too ordinary to
beginning.openingChinese: 被水淹沒的聖堂裡，沒有官員能給出確切答覆。聚集的住戶要求賠償，米拉則要求職員公開封閉街道水閘的命令。 遠處鐘聲響起，貨車從破路上隆隆駛過，會議只好暫停。米拉趁機清點出口、檢查門能否從內側開啟，並詢問是否有人需要椅子。多年稽核經驗使她知道，最重大失敗常藏在被視為平凡的小事裡。若門從錯誤的一邊上鎖，報告還沒簽完便可能成災。她在桌首放上白紙，請最年輕的工人畫出民眾真正走的路，而非市府地圖上的漂亮線條。
beginning.closingEnglish: evacuation ledger. A red seal showed that the floodgates had been transferred to a private board eleven minutes before the water rose. Director Voss's name was absent, but a numbered mark beside the seal belonged to his office. She took three photographs, placed one copy with a resident, and walked home without her former official badge. By morning the board would learn she had begun asking questions. For once, she wanted them to know.
beginning.closingChinese: 在出口，米拉攤開撤離帳冊。紅色印章顯示水位暴漲前十一分鐘，水閘已移交私人董事會。沃斯的名字不在上頭，印旁編號卻屬於他的辦公室。她拍下三張照片，留一份給居民，沒有戴舊官徽便返家。天亮後董事會就會知道她開始追查；這次，她希望他們知道。

middle.openingEnglish: An acute fever brought the administrator to the reservoir. He accused Yara of bias and insisted the illness was not contagious, though the defendant in another case had used the same excuse. Yara asked the administrator to describe the fever cases by onset time rather than political district. People supplied from the same branch had fallen ill on different streets. That did not settle the cause, and she said so before anyone could turn the pattern into a slogan. Mira requested a clean copy of the water distribution plan. The administrator wanted a statement denying danger. Yara gave him instructions for seeking c
middle.openingChinese: 急性高燒讓行政官趕到水庫。他指責雅拉偏頗，堅稱疾病不具傳染性；另一案件被告也曾用同樣藉口。 雅拉請行政官按發病時間而非政治分區描述病例。同一支線供水、住不同街的人都病了。她先說明這仍不足以確定病因，免得模式被變成口號。米拉要求乾淨供水圖。行政官要一份否認危險的聲明，雅拉給的卻是就醫指示；無證據的保證可能讓病人等到更嚴重。
middle.closingEnglish: ocated the reservoir's original emergency drawing beneath a revised plan. A second valve had been designed to release pressure into an empty service tunnel. Someone had painted its handle the same color as the wall. Mira ordered the tunnel inspected and the neighboring residents warned before any test. The board demanded speed. She answered that the city had been injured by people who treated a warning as an obstacle to their schedules.
middle.closingChinese: 戴終於在修改後圖紙下面找到水庫最初的緊急設計。第二道閥門原可把壓力導入空的維修隧道，有人卻把把手漆成牆色。米拉要求測試前先檢查隧道、通知鄰居。董事會催促加快，她說城市正是被把警告視為行程障礙的人傷害。

ending.openingEnglish: Standing alongside children, Mira opened an alternate route beside the restored canal. The word communism appeared in a hostile leaflet, but she insisted that the crucial question was who could inspect the records. A child stopped at the canal notice and asked whether the new path could close during another emergency. Mira pointed to the place where a closure would have to be recorded with its reason and review date. The answer was less exciting than declaring that nothing bad could happen again. It was also something the child could check later. A resident carrying the hostile leaflet joined them. Mira offered t
ending.openingChinese: 米拉與孩子並肩站著，開啟修復運河旁的替代道路。敵意傳單寫著共產主義，她堅持真正關鍵是誰能檢查紀錄。 孩子在運河公告前問，再有緊急狀況，新路會不會關。米拉指給他看，關閉必須記理由與複核日期。答案沒有「壞事永不再來」動聽，卻能日後查證。持敵意傳單的居民走近，她同樣解釋，讓對方讀真條文後仍可批評憲章。
ending.closingEnglish: ublic three times. The city board now published its accounts and allowed residents to challenge any emergency order. Mira had declined a permanent executive seat. She taught a free evening class on reading contracts and kept her old notebook on a shelf where students could examine it. On the first page she wrote a final sentence: “A strong city does not need one woman who cannot be defeated. It needs people who no longer have to kneel.”
ending.closingChinese: 六個月後，水閘已公開測試三次。新的市民董事會公布帳目，居民也可質疑任何緊急命令。米拉婉拒永久行政席位，改教免費夜課，教大家讀合約，舊筆記本放在學生可查閱的架上。扉頁她寫下最後一句：「堅強的城市不需要一名永不敗的女人，需要的是再也不必下跪的人們。」

books.name: 總裁，這份合約我改了｜第一卷：她刪掉的那一條
books.hook: 他說沒有人能改合約。她當面刪掉了那一條。
books.description: 26歲設計師林蔓為了保住母親的小店，走進晴港集團。總裁沈予川要她簽下合作合約，她卻當著他的面刪掉最重要的一條。

beginning.openingEnglish: The man behind the long desk did not look up when I came in. He was talking on the phone, wearing a dark coat that probably cost more than my mother's whole store. I put my wet bag on the floor. Water ran onto his clean shoes. He looked down at them, then at me. "Your meeting was at nine," he said. "Your lift stopped at eight fifty," I said. "I took twenty floors of stairs. You are welcome."
beginning.openingChinese: 長桌後的男人在我進門時沒有抬頭。他穿著可能比媽媽整間店還貴的深色外套講電話。我把濕袋子放在地上，水流到他乾淨的鞋面。他低頭看鞋，再看我。「妳的會議是九點。」「你的電梯八點五十就停了，」我說，「我爬了二十層樓。不客氣。」
beginning.closingEnglish: "Where did you get this?" I asked. He looked at the open contract, then at my name on the first page. Something in his face closed. "Your father was Daniel Lin?" Outside the office, someone called his next meeting. Neither of us moved. I had climbed twenty floors to save a store. Now the richest man I had ever met was holding the other end of my father's last mistake. Or the first proof that it had never been his.
beginning.closingChinese: 「這是哪裡來的？」我問。他看著攤開的合約，再看首頁的名字，表情忽然收起來。「妳父親是林立安？」門外有人提醒下一場會議，我們都沒動。我爬二十層樓是為了救店，如今眼前最有錢的男人握著父親最後一個錯誤的另一端——或者，證明那從來不是他的錯誤的第一項證據。

middle.openingEnglish: The chairwoman's gift arrived in a long green box. Mother and I stared at it for a minute before opening the lid. There was no necklace or evening dress inside. A heavy pair of cloth scissors lay in soft paper beside a handwritten note. I have heard about your work. Please come for tea. It was signed by Clara Shen, Adrian's grandmother and the woman whose name stood above every other name on the company wall. Mother knew the scissors were excellent. I knew a useful gift could still be a way of making it difficult to refuse.
middle.openingChinese: 董事長的禮物裝在長綠盒裡送來。媽媽和我看了一分鐘才開蓋，裡面不是項鍊或晚禮服，而是一把沉甸甸的裁布剪，放在軟紙上，旁邊有手寫便條：聽說了妳的作品，請來喝茶。署名是沈克蘿拉，沈予川的祖母，公司牆上名字排在所有人之上的女人。媽媽知道那剪刀很好。我知道，一份有用的禮物，仍可能是讓人難以拒絕的方法。
middle.closingEnglish: le but accepted the key with a dated copy of her note. Outside, Adrian asked whether he could walk me to the bus stop. I said yes. We did not speak about the family until the bus lights appeared. Then he asked a question I had not expected. "What should I have asked five years ago?" I looked at him. "The same things you are finally asking now." He nodded, and for once neither of us tried to soften an answer that deserved to remain hard.
middle.closingChinese: 我把剪刀留在桌上，帶走鑰匙和註明日期的便條副本。外面，沈予川問可不可以陪我走到公車站。我說好。直到車燈出現，我們都沒談他家。接著，他問了我沒料到的問題：「五年前，我應該問什麼？」我看著他。「和你現在終於開始問的一樣。」他點頭。這一次，誰也沒試著把一個本該刺痛人的答案說得柔軟。

ending.openingEnglish: Mother read the findings at the counter while the street woke around us. The baker arrived with fresh bread. The bookseller brought the bill for the window boards and refused to let me call it a gift. "A fair price is easier to remember," he said. I paid him from the first nurse order. The small exchange pleased Mother more than any speech about a successful launch. Our store had work. It had debts. It had a boarded window and a machine that still needed attention. It also had a future we could discuss without pretending somebody rich had bought it for us.
ending.openingChinese: 媽媽在櫃檯讀複查發現，街道在身旁甦醒。麵包師送來新鮮麵包，書店老闆拿來封窗板帳單，不准我稱它禮物。「公平的價格比較好記。」我用護理師第一筆訂單收入付錢。這場小交易，比成功發表會的演說更讓媽媽高興。我們的店有工作、有債，有封板窗和待修機器，也有一個能討論的未來，不必假裝是有錢人替我們買的。
ending.closingEnglish: and closed the folder carefully. This time, we would not begin by asking one frightened person to face the company alone. Adrian called Rose. Owen asked the woman to meet us with the workers she trusted. Mother made more tea. I moved the table toward the window, where the light was better. The first line I crossed out had been about owning my designs. The next line would be about who was allowed to own the truth of somebody else's life.
ending.closingChinese: 五年沒有讓這招變新，只讓它多了一個可借的名字。我把爸爸的扣子放進錢杯，小心闔上資料夾。這次，不會再從要求一個害怕的人獨自面對公司開始。沈予川打給蘿絲，歐文請那女人帶可信任的工人來，媽媽多泡些茶。我把桌子往窗邊推，光比較好。第一次劃掉的條款，是誰擁有我的設計；下一條，會是誰有權擁有別人人生的真相。

books.name: 借雷之城
books.hook: 城市護盾的第二種節奏，藏著姊姊的下落嗎？
books.description: 林知夏從歌劇院銅盤聽見城市護盾的第二種節奏，追查失蹤姊姊留下的禁忌指令。

beginning.openingEnglish: The morning assembly filled Thunder City Square with banners proclaiming the ministry's favorite slogan: STRENGTH IS SAFETY. Lin Zhixia, nineteen, stood behind the ticket counter of the old opera hall, polishing a copper dial with a cloth dampened by weak acid. The city had ordered all youthful workers to attend a combat demonstration, yet the hall's manager insisted that someone stay to sweep with a broom. He called her a coward for accepting such a duty. Zhixia did not answer. The dial beneath her fingers vibrated every time the invisible shield above the city flashed, and she could hear a second beat hidden in
beginning.openingChinese: 清晨的集會讓霆京廣場滿是旗幟，上頭印著管理部最愛的口號：「力量就是安全。」十九歲的林知夏站在老歌劇院售票櫃檯後，用沾了稀酸液的布擦拭銅製圓盤。市府要求所有年輕工作者去看武技示範，但劇院經理堅持留一人拿掃帚清掃，還嘲笑接受工作的她是膽小鬼。知夏沒有回嘴。每當城市上空的無形護盾閃光，她指下的圓盤就會震動，而且她聽得出官方節奏裡還藏著第二種拍子。
beginning.closingEnglish: THIRD BEAT. Zhixia tested the rhythm against the shield anyway, carefully stopping before the forbidden note. For an instant the dark roof became transparent. She saw hundreds of people sleeping in narrow underground beds while wires took light from their foreheads. Then the vision vanished, leaving her with one terrible thought: perhaps the shield did not protect everyone equally because it was built out of some people's stolen lives.
beginning.closingChinese: 銅盤卻依舊低鳴。知夏從盤底找到一張使用說明，字跡竟屬於三年前失蹤的姊姊林晏。姊姊當時就讀全城最高等的武學院。卡片上有一句畫了底線：「絕不可配合第三拍。」知夏仍小心試著讓節奏與護盾同步，只在禁忌音符前停住。一瞬間屋頂像變透明了，她看見幾百個人睡在地下狹床上，電線正從他們額頭抽取光。幻象消失後，她只剩一個可怕念頭：也許護盾無法平等保護每個人，是因為它本來就由一些人被偷走的生命建成。

middle.openingEnglish: Spring blossom opened along the river even as the shield grew unstable. Vela called a conference in the abandoned station, bringing together students, miners, healers, and representatives from Lower Nine. Their proposal was simple but dangerous: replace forced extraction with a universal network of voluntary pulse sharing. Economics experts warned that the existing power foundation could collapse if the transition was careless. A choir of schoolchildren opened the meeting with Yan's forgotten melody. Its third beat made every lamp in the hall flicker. For a moment Zhixia felt her sister standing beside her, not a
middle.openingChinese: 春天的花沿河綻放，護盾卻越來越不穩。薇拉在廢棄車站召開會議，集合學員、礦工、醫護與第九下城代表。他們的提案簡單而危險：用自願共享的普遍脈息網，取代強制抽取。經濟專家警告，若轉換草率，現有能源基礎可能崩潰。孩子合唱團以林晏遺忘的旋律開場，第三拍讓會場所有燈微微閃動。一瞬間知夏覺得姊姊就在身旁，不再是傳說，而是一個曾用心寫曲子的人。
middle.closingEnglish: site: that they had allowed themselves to be alone for too long. The city had taught everyone to measure personal rank, so its citizens had forgotten how to build shared strength. Kai offered her a leisurely walk through the station garden, where tiny flowers had pushed through cracks in concrete. They did not speak of victory. They talked about food, books, and childhood, ordinary things that made their difficult promise worth keeping.
middle.closingChinese: 散會後，凱發現知夏坐在月臺邊聽河聲。他問她是否後悔把那麼多人拖入危險。她說自己更怕相反的事：他們過去讓彼此孤單太久。城市教每個人衡量個人等級，於是市民忘了如何建立共同力量。凱提議慢慢走過車站小花園，小花正從混凝土裂縫鑽出。他們沒有談勝利，只聊食物、書和童年；那些平凡事物正是艱難承諾值得維持的理由。

ending.openingEnglish: One year later, Thunder City was still repairing the enormous damage left by the old system. Several companies had gone bankrupt, and insurance claims filled offices from the crowded center to the rural outskirts. Yet the new public registry included people once ignored because of disability, low rank, or lack of formal employment. A graph outside the former ministry showed how voluntary pulse sharing had lengthened the shield's safe operating hours without forcing anyone to surrender memories. Zhixia studied the figures with cautious pride. They were not proof of perfection. They were proof that a different inte
ending.openingChinese: 一年後，霆京仍在修復舊制度留下的巨大傷害。好幾家公司破產，保險申請塞滿從繁忙市中心到鄉村外緣的辦公室。新的公共名冊卻包含過去因身心障礙、等級低落或沒有正式工作而被忽略的人。舊管理部外有張圖表，顯示自願共享脈息讓護盾安全運作時間延長，而不必強迫任何人交出記憶。知夏帶著謹慎驕傲看數字。它們不是完美證明，而是不同意圖能造出不同未來的證據。
ending.closingEnglish: whether she missed the days when a single powerful fighter could solve everything. Zhixia smiled. "Those days existed mostly in slogans," she said. She opened the hall doors and heard the city wake: trams, kitchens, conversation, and the soft third beat beneath them all. The world was still vast and uncertain. But now, whenever the shield sang, thousands of people could answer together—and none had to disappear to keep the others safe.
ending.closingChinese: 夏回到老歌劇院。銅盤被放在玻璃後，不再是祕密武器，而是人人可研究的教具。窗邊凝著露水，一班自願救援課正在廣場集合。孩子問她是否懷念一位強大武者就能解決一切的日子。知夏笑了：「那些日子大多只存在於口號裡。」她打開劇院大門，聽見城市甦醒：電車、廚房、交談，以及底下柔和的第三拍。世界依舊廣闊而不確定，但如今護盾唱起歌時，成千上萬的人都能一起回應——再也不必讓誰消失，才能讓其他人安全。

books.name: 灰潮檔案
books.hook: 母親死去十二年，卻寄來一張日期是明天的拘票。
books.description: 海面平靜了十七天，洪水警報卻突然響起。銀行出納員交給莉娜一只紅信封：裡面是據說早已溺死的母親的照片，以及一張日期寫著明天的拘票。為了追查寄件者，她重回自己曾工作的檔案館。有人在修改紀錄，也有人正等著她把證據交出來。

beginning.openingEnglish: The flood siren sounded at six, although the sea had been calm for seventeen days. Lena was standing in a bank queue when the teller pushed a red envelope under the glass. There was no money inside, only a photograph of her mother, who had supposedly drowned twelve years earlier. On its reverse, a single sentence had been written in the old government's shorthand: Do not abbreviate the names of the living. Lena knew that hand. Her mother used to write that way on grocery lists. A uniformed guard approached, and the teller immediately pretended to count coins. The envelope smelled of salt and smoke. Beneath the ph
beginning.openingChinese: 洪水警報在六點響起，儘管海面已經平靜了十七天。莉娜正排在銀行隊伍裡，出納員忽然從玻璃窗下推來一只紅色信封。裡面沒有錢，只有一張她母親的照片——母親據說十二年前就溺死了。照片背後，以舊政府的速記方式寫著一句話：「活人的姓名不可縮寫。」莉娜認得那筆跡。母親以前寫購物清單時就這樣寫。一名制服警衛走近，出納員立刻假裝清點硬幣。信封帶著鹽與煙的氣味。照片下方竟是一張逮捕莉娜的拘票，日期寫著明天。寄件者不是知道未來，就是有權決定未來將如何被記錄。
beginning.closingEnglish: ng into position. She understood the bargain. If she surrendered the proof, her mother would remain dead on paper, and every person whose name had been stolen would remain invisible. She slid the cabinet drawer shut, pocketed the register key, and spoke loudly enough for Havel to hear. "Then you'll have to come down and explain whose lives you're protecting." A light went out. Jory caught her hand. Together they descended into the dark.
beginning.closingChinese: 妳在那裡。」哈維爾局長站在樓上某處，像獵人般耐心。「把照片留下，我們可以把妳的罪當作一場誤會。」莉娜聽見靴子挪動，正逐步包圍他們。她明白這筆交易的意思。如果交出證據，母親在紙上就永遠是死人，所有被奪走姓名的人也將繼續隱形。她關上抽屜，把登記簿鑰匙放進口袋，刻意提高音量，讓哈維爾聽見：「那你得親自下來，解釋你們到底在保護誰的命。」燈熄了。喬里握住她的手。兩人一起走下黑暗中的階梯。

middle.openingEnglish: The hospital's old computer contained an inventory of every person transferred to Island Nine. Lena discovered it inside a suitcase delivered by her mother, along with a battered encyclopedia and a child's drawing. On the first page, a simple algebra formula described how the council had distributed food according to declared population. The formula was mathematically sound. Its assumptions were not. Residents whose names had been removed received no allotment, and the supplies meant for them were diverted elsewhere. The document's author was listed as Dr. Vale, Lena's mother. Lena felt the past begin to haunt he
middle.openingChinese: 醫院舊電腦裡存有轉往第九島所有人的清冊。莉娜在母親送來的行李箱裡找到它，旁邊還有一本破舊百科全書和孩子的畫。第一頁用簡單代數公式說明議會如何依申報人口分配糧食。公式在數學上沒有錯，假設卻有問題。姓名被移除的居民拿不到配額，原本屬於他們的物資就被挪作他用。文件作者是維爾醫師，也就是莉娜的母親。莉娜感到過去再度纏上自己。母親曾在實驗開始前協助設計配給模式，相信精確紀錄能保存有限資源。沒想到同樣的模式，讓人更容易從預算中抹去。莉娜記得母親曾說，細心記帳是殘酷的反
middle.closingEnglish: her head. They sat for a long time without speaking. Outside, rain began to fall, and the hospital lamps glowed beneath the eaves. Lena finally handed her the draft statement. "You don't get to hide behind the good you did afterward," she said. "Neither do I." Her mother read the first page, then asked for a pen. They would sign together, not because their choices had been equal, but because both had left marks that needed to be named.
middle.closingChinese: 不說完整故事。「因為我感到羞恥，」母親承認，「我不斷說服自己，後來救了孩子，就足以抵消早先做的事。」莉娜問孩子們是否知道，是誰寫出傷害他們的體系。母親低下頭。兩人長久無語。外頭開始下雨，醫院簷下亮起燈。莉娜終於把聲明草稿交給母親。「妳不能躲在後來做的好事後面，」她說，「我也不能。」母親讀完第一頁，要求拿筆。兩人將一起簽名，不是因為責任相等，而是因為兩人都留下了必須被說出的痕跡。

ending.openingEnglish: Six months later, Lena entered the restored archive amid the quiet anticipation of its opening day. A new apprentice stood at the desk, learning how to compute the number of medical claims without treating people as mere totals. The city's treasury had released the remainder of the misused funds for clinics and public record offices. Every transaction could be inspected. The building still carried the low vibration of water pumps beneath the floor, but the sound no longer frightened Lena. A knowledgeable worker explained the new emergency system to visitors, emphasizing that no single official could alter the rec
ending.openingChinese: 六個月後，莉娜在安靜期待中走進修復完成的檔案館。新學徒站在櫃檯，學習如何計算醫療申請數量，而不把人當成總數。城市金庫已把遭挪用款項的剩餘部分發還診所與公共登記處。每筆交易都能受檢查。地板下仍有水泵低低震動，這聲音卻不再嚇壞莉娜。熟悉系統的工人向訪客解釋新緊急機制，特別強調任何官員都不能在沒有獨立見證人的情況下修改紀錄。人們帶著拐杖、孩子和一包包文件前來。有些多年遭拘留，有些被舊登記簿寫成死屍，明明仍活得好好的。
ending.closingEnglish: nvelope delivered at the bank, the warrant dated tomorrow, and the handwriting that had begun everything. She took out a fresh sheet of paper and wrote the rule above the entrance: Do not abbreviate the names of the living. Beneath it she added one more sentence: Let them tell their own stories. Outside, the sun moved across the harbor. The water was calm, and no siren sounded. The city went on living, imperfectly, openly, and together.
ending.closingChinese: 料，都附有同意說明。檔案館不完美。爭議仍會發生，物資仍有短缺，有些傷口不會很快癒合。但再也沒有人只為了申請食物或治療，就得交出整段人生。莉娜想起銀行收到的紅信封、日期寫著明天的拘票，以及開啟一切的字跡。她拿起新紙，在入口上方寫下規則：「活人的姓名不可縮寫。」又在下面加上一句：「讓他們自己說故事。」外頭太陽越過港口。水面平靜，沒有警報響起。城市繼續活著，不完美，卻公開，也在一起。

books.name: 逆鐘旅店
books.hook: 鐘響十三下，一個活人就從名冊上消失了。
books.description: 鐘聲敲了十三下，優娜身旁的旅人便失去了合法姓名。守衛帶走他，只留下受傷的狐狸幼崽與一夾牙科紀錄。優娜每天清掃刪去姓名的辦公室，卻第一次發現，文件裡竟有自己的簽名——還有失蹤弟弟的照片。若鐘聲能決定一個人是否存在，她該相信記憶，還是名冊？

beginning.openingEnglish: The bell rang thirteen times, and the man beside Yuna vanished from the city's legal register. He did not disappear from the street; he simply became someone the guards were allowed to arrest without giving a reason. Yuna, a janitor at the Hall of Names, watched the guards clasp his wrists in iron cuffs. The man was a pilgrim who had arrived before dawn. All he carried was a wounded fox cub and a folder of dental records. "There must be a mistake," he said. The tallest guard answered with a government directive: every unregistered resident must be detained before sunset. It had been issued in the name of the dict
beginning.openingChinese: 鐘聲敲了十三下，站在優娜身旁的男人便從城市的法定戶籍上消失了。他並未從街道上憑空蒸發；只是從那一刻起，守衛可以不說理由就把他逮捕。身為「姓名大廳」清潔工的優娜，看著守衛用鐵銬扣住他的雙腕。男人是黎明前才抵達的朝聖旅人，全部行李只有一隻受傷的狐狸幼崽，和一夾牙科紀錄。「一定搞錯了，」他說。最高大的守衛唸出一項政府指令：所有未登記居民必須在日落前拘留。命令以那位隔著密封窗戶統治城市的獨裁者之名頒布。優娜知道規矩，她每天都清掃刪去姓名的辦公室。但過去，她從沒站得
beginning.closingEnglish: ore hers. A third carried a word she had never seen: REHEARSAL. Yuna wanted to pull the switch, but the cub cried out, and she realized that the panel was warm. Something on the other side was alive and working. She withdrew her hand. Instead of taking the easiest action, she copied each symbol onto her sleeve with cleaning chalk. Then she climbed toward the bell tower, where someone was already striking the metal for a fourteenth time.
beginning.closingChinese: 牆面交會。她抱著狐狸幼崽鑽了進去，等柯文的腳步聲遠去。暗道裡有塊黃銅面板，裝著二十個細小開關。其中一個刻著弟弟的名字，另一個刻著她自己的。第三個標著從未見過的字：「預演」。優娜很想扳下開關，但狐狸幼崽突然哀叫，她才發現面板微微發熱。牆的另一邊，某種東西正活著、運作著。她收回手，沒有選擇最容易的動作，而是用清潔粉筆把每個符號抄在袖子上。接著她爬向鐘樓；樓上有人正準備敲響第十四聲。

middle.openingEnglish: The only route into the royal records wing passed through a theater reserved for the eclipse celebration. Hale arranged for Yuna to join the crew as a sanitation assistant, while Miro entered disguised as an electrician. In the dressing rooms, performers applied cosmetics beneath mirrors surrounded by tiny lights. One actress complained that the glamour of the production concealed a disagreement over pay. Her costume was stylish but uncomfortable, and the false eyelashes kept falling off whenever she blinked. Yuna helped repair the makeup without drawing attention to herself. Behind the stage, a worker offered he
middle.openingChinese: 通往王室檔案區唯一的路必須經過為日蝕慶典保留的劇院。海爾安排優娜以衛生清潔員身分進入，米羅則偽裝成電工。化妝間裡，演員對著周圍亮著小燈的鏡子塗抹化妝品。一名女演員抱怨華麗表演掩蓋了薪資爭議。她的服裝時髦卻不舒服，假睫毛一眨眼就掉。優娜幫她修好妝容，不想引人注意。舞台後方，一名工人遞給她乾餅乾，提醒劇院通風不穩。「導演全靠我們維持美麗的表面，」他說，「卻忘了工人一停，戲也演不下去。」這番話讓優娜想起姓名大廳的清潔工。他們通常隱形，直到缺席才會被人看見。
middle.closingEnglish: f a theatrical program. The contention was plain: if a performance could force an audience to remember someone else's life, it was no longer entertainment but a medical intervention. Yuna copied that sentence into her notes and asked the clerk to preserve the original paper. She did not know whether the court would accept the evidence. She knew only that the people affected should be allowed to question the definition imposed upon them.
middle.closingChinese: 無法改變世界。但證人正在聚集，隱藏紀錄也開始講出不同故事。她帶著職員封好的信封離開劇院，知道自己不只獲得證據，也背負保護來源的責任。 封口信封裡是一份寫在戲院節目單空白處的病患同意權爭論。爭點很清楚：如果一場表演能強迫觀眾記得別人的人生，那就不再是娛樂，而是醫療介入。優娜把那句話抄進筆記，請職員保管原件。她不知道法院是否接受證據，只知道受影響的人應有權質疑強加在自己身上的定義。

ending.openingEnglish: Six months after the hearing, Yuna returned to a villa above the harbor, carrying a manuscript in a waterproof case. The abandoned building had been rehabilitated into a small inn and recovery center, with rooms for people whose memories had been transferred without permission. Its entrance displayed a bilateral agreement: no treatment would begin unless patient and clinician both understood what it involved, and the patient could stop at any time. A renowned physician had helped train local nurses, but she refused to be treated as the city's savior. "Recovery is not a performance," she reminded the volunteers. R
ending.openingChinese: 聽證六個月後，優娜帶著裝在防水盒裡的手稿，回到港口上方的一棟別墅。這座廢棄建築已修復成小旅店與復健中心，提供房間給曾遭違反意願移植記憶的人。入口張貼雙方協議：病人與醫師都了解療程、病人可隨時停止，治療才得開始。一名著名醫師協助訓練當地護理師，卻拒絕被當成城市救世主。「復原不是表演。」她提醒志工。任坐在窗下，慢慢把短句抄進筆記本。有些日子他清楚記得童年；另一些日子，他寫幾個字就會疲倦。優娜已學會不再以他說話是否流利，衡量兩人的親近程度。重要的是他能自己決定何
ending.closingEnglish: ove the door. Yuna considered the question. She remembered the first night, when a pilgrim had lost his rights at the thirteenth stroke; she remembered Ren's frightened eyes and all the people who had refused to let his name disappear. "Because you can stay here without being counted down to someone else's command," she said. From the garden came the sound of a child laughing. The bell did not ring. People spoke their own names instead.
ending.closingChinese: 牌。沒有人試圖抹去它曾造成的傷害。紀錄仍開放獨立調查者查閱，私人記憶則交還給各自的主人。入口處，一名旅客問這棟樓為何叫「逆鐘旅店」，門上明明沒有時鐘。優娜想了想。她記起最初那夜，一名朝聖者在第十三聲鐘響後失去權利；記起任驚恐的眼神，以及所有拒絕讓他的名字消失的人。「因為你待在這裡，不必倒數等待別人的命令。」她說。花園傳來孩子的笑聲。鐘沒有響。人們改用自己的聲音，說出自己的名字。

books.name: 貝殼灣的影子節
books.hook: 最吵的節日裡，一隻水豚決定為安靜的人留下一束光。
books.description: 在貝殼灣，水豚塞拉希望讓安靜的居民也能享受節日。她與刺蝟達洛、烏龜烏瑪借用舊廳堂，準備一場沒有大聲音樂的影子戲。布幕、燈光、故事和分工都帶來新難題。三人逐步學會傾聽不同觀眾，讓一場演出成為每個人都能參與的公共創作。

beginning.openingEnglish: In Shell Bay, the summer fair was always loud. Sela, a young capybara who liked drawing, saw her small neighbor cover his ears near the music. She asked why everyone had to enjoy the fair in the same way. She wanted to make something gentle, but she did not know where to start. A small bug rested on the wall while Sela watched the fair from a quiet place. She used a camera to remember how the hall looked before their work began. The fact was simple: some neighbors went home when the music became too loud. Sela gave a friendly smile to a child who stood far from the crowd. They took a short break and shared water.
beginning.openingChinese: 在貝殼灣，夏季節慶總是很吵。喜歡畫畫的年輕水豚塞拉，看見小鄰居在音樂旁摀住耳朵。她心想：為什麼每個人都得用同一種方式享受節日？她想做點溫柔的事，卻不知道從何開始。塞拉在安靜處看節慶時，一隻小蟲停在牆上。 她用相機記下開工前廳堂的樣子。 事實很簡單：有些鄰居一聽見太大聲的音樂就回家。 塞拉對站在人群外的孩子友善地笑了。大家短暫休息，一起喝水。當每個人都能說出自己的需要時，辛苦的工作也變得比較容易。休息後，他們帶著更清楚的計畫回去做事。
beginning.closingEnglish: r sing, she asked. Sela said she could simply sit and watch. The woman smiled and asked when she could come back. Sela could not give her a date yet, so Uma offered to bring the news when the plan was ready. Then Daro put the fish flat in a box. They would use it again, but first they needed to ask about the hall. Sela looked at the white cloth one last time. This was no longer only an idea in her head. Someone was waiting to hear more.
beginning.closingChinese: 離開前，一位年長婦人在開著的門邊停下。她聽到塞拉談安靜表演，便問是否得參加遊戲或唱歌。塞拉說，她可以只坐著看。婦人笑了，問什麼時候能再來。塞拉還無法給日期，烏瑪便答應，計畫確定後會通知她。接著，達洛把紙魚平放進箱。他們會再用它，但得先問清廳堂的事。塞拉最後看了一眼白布。這不再只是她腦中的點子；已有人等著聽更多消息。

middle.openingEnglish: The afternoon sun came through a wide window and made the shadow fish hard to see. Daro thought the lamp was broken. Uma looked carefully and found that the bright window, not the lamp, was the problem. They decided to test the show at the same time of day as the festival. The fish shadow looked beautiful when the bright window was covered. Daro used a brown card to make the shell keeper stand out. A school camp visited the bay and asked to see a short practice. The friends placed a chair beside the door for the visiting teacher.
middle.openingChinese: 下午陽光從寬窗照進來，讓魚影變得難看清。達洛以為燈壞了。烏瑪仔細觀察後發現，問題不是燈，而是明亮的窗戶。他們決定在與節日相同的時段測試表演。遮住明亮窗戶後，魚影看起來很美。 達洛用棕色卡紙讓貝殼守護者更顯眼。 一個學校營隊來到海灣，想看簡短練習。 朋友們在門旁放了一張椅子給來訪老師。
middle.closingEnglish: ng the door. She could still feel air moving as the fish crossed the white space. Daro stood beside the window and asked her to call when the shadow became hard to see. Uma wrote down the time of that change. The room, the light, and the chairs had to work together; a good fish shape could not do everything by itself. At sunset, Sela took the window cloth down. They would put it up for the next test, with the same clear space around it.
middle.closingChinese: 下午測試雖短，塞拉離開前仍想從後面再看一次。窗布擋住直射布幕的陽光，沒有遮住門；魚穿過白色空間時，她仍感覺得到空氣流動。達洛站在窗旁，請她在影子難看清時出聲。烏瑪記下變化時間。房間、光和椅子得一起配合，好的魚形無法獨自完成一切。日落後，塞拉把窗布取下。下次測試再掛回去時，周圍也會保留同樣的空間。

ending.openingEnglish: During the last week of the trial month, the town held a meeting about the hall’s future. Oren brought the notes from the one-month trial plan, and neighbors shared what they hoped to do next. Sela came with Daro and Uma. She was not afraid to speak, but she was careful not to speak for everyone else. The friends were able to teach new groups how to use the screen safely. Sela was no longer afraid that every change would ruin her idea. Oren said the town would allow different groups to try public events. A small cat came to the meeting with a soft doll and waited near the door.
ending.openingChinese: 試行月的最後一週，小鎮針對廳堂未來再次開會。歐倫帶來一個月試行計畫的紀錄，鄰居們也分享未來想做的活動。塞拉與達洛、烏瑪一起出席。她不怕發言，但很小心不替所有人說話。朋友們有能力教新團體安全使用布幕。 塞拉不再害怕任何改變都會毀掉她的點子。 歐倫說，鎮上會允許不同團體試辦公開活動。 一隻小貓帶著柔軟布娃娃來參加會議，在門旁等候。
ending.closingEnglish: la showed them the calendar instead of promising an extra show of her own. Other neighbors would have their turn to lead. On the empty program cover, she wrote one word: Together. Below it she put the names of the friends and helpers who wanted to be named. Then she closed the book. Tomorrow a different person could open the door and find enough room for a different story. Sela walked home with nothing left to prove on the little stage.
ending.closingChinese: 烏瑪檢查燈兩次，才把它關上。達洛整理房間，留出乾淨桌子給下一組。門口，一家人問下次藝術日到貝殼灣旅行的事。塞拉指給他們看日曆，沒有再承諾加演自己的戲。其他鄰居也會輪到帶領活動。她在空白節目單封面寫下一個字：一起。下面是朋友，以及願意具名的幫手姓名。然後她闔上本子。明天，不同的人可以打開門，為不同故事找到足夠空間。塞拉走回家，不必再在小舞台上證明什麼。

books.name: 不必編造的約會
books.hook: 一張被誤會的合照，讓兩個對手開始練習假約會。
books.description: 二十二歲的紙燈社社長蓮，和二十四歲的創客社社長俊，是曾經互相競爭的對手。為了爭取跨社團補助，兩人合作製作「與城市約會」的步行展。宣傳照上的一顆紅心讓同學誤會他們在交往，於是兩人訂下明確界線，只在事先同意的演出場景扮演情侶。隨著一間被遺忘的公共閱覽室浮出水面，他們在調查歷史、安全修復、公開資源與風雨考驗中學會真正合作，也逐步理解親密關係應由自己選擇。

beginning.openingEnglish: At the first meeting of the autumn term, Lian arrived at the university café carrying a plain folder and a clear plan. She was twenty-two and led the Paper Lantern Club. Across the room sat Jun, a twenty-four-year-old design student with a serious face and a short beard. His Makers Club had beaten hers in the spring contest. Now the school would give one grant to a joint team, and their advisers wanted the two clubs to work together. Lian did not like the idea. Jun raised one hand and said, “I do not want a fight either. I want a project that works.”
beginning.openingChinese: 秋季學期第一次會議，二十二歲的蓮帶著素色資料夾和明確計畫走進大學咖啡館。她是「紙燈社」社長。房間另一頭坐著二十四歲的設計系學生俊，神情嚴肅，留著短鬍子。他的「創客社」曾在春季競賽中擊敗紙燈社。現在學校只會把一筆補助交給跨社團團隊，兩邊的指導老師希望他們合作。蓮不喜歡這個主意。俊舉起手說：「我也不想吵架。我只想做出真正能運作的作品。」
beginning.closingEnglish: e date on its cover did not match the gardener's memory. She sent Jun a note: “Our story may have a real question inside it.” He answered with a drawing of the wall and three possible places where a record might be stored. Their agreement did not promise friendship, much less love. Yet it did promise to tell the truth. For two students who had spent a year trying to beat each other, that small promise already felt larger than a contest.
beginning.closingChinese: 睡前，蓮打開老花園檔案。報告少了最後一頁，封面的日期也與園丁的記憶不同。她傳訊息給俊：「我們的故事裡，可能藏著真正的疑問。」他回覆一張圍牆草圖，標出三個可能保存紀錄的地方。他們的協議沒有承諾友情，更沒有承諾愛情；卻承諾要說真話。對兩個花了一年想擊敗彼此的學生而言，這個小承諾已經比競賽更重要。

middle.openingEnglish: The repair engineer met the clubs in a room above the market. He laid out a metal chart showing the amount of wood and support needed for the old roof. The price was higher than they had expected. Jun asked whether a lighter repair could match the safety rules. The engineer shook his head. “I will not work against the evidence to save a few coins,” he said. Lian respected that answer. The building was an old treasure to the town, but its beauty did not make it safe. They needed leadership that could tell people what was possible rather than what sounded pleasant.
middle.openingChinese: 維修工程師在市場樓上的房間與社團見面。他攤開金屬結構圖，列出舊屋頂需要的木材和支撐數量。價格比他們預想高。俊問較輕便的修復能否符合安全規則，工程師搖頭。「我不會為了省幾個錢就違背證據，」他說。蓮尊重這個回答。這棟建築是鎮上的老寶物，但美麗不代表安全。他們需要敢於說出可行範圍、而不只講好聽話的領導。
middle.closingEnglish: lic meeting. She agreed, then asked one condition of her own: they would explain the budget in ordinary words instead of hiding behind charts. “If you can explain it to a friend, you understand it,” she said. “And if I cannot?” Jun asked. “Then we learn together.” He smiled at that. Lian walked home knowing the cost of the roof was still large and the road ahead uncertain. Yet she no longer felt she had to carry the whole problem alone.
middle.closingChinese: 分開前，俊問蓮願不願意一起準備下一場公開會議。她答應，但提出條件：要用普通人能懂的話解釋預算，不要躲在圖表後面。「能向朋友講清楚，才算真正理解，」她說。「如果我講不清呢？」俊問。「那我們一起學。」他笑了。蓮走回家時知道屋頂費用仍很高，前路仍不確定，卻不再覺得自己必須獨自承擔所有問題。

ending.openingEnglish: The award ceremony took place in the same hall where the clubs had first argued about their plan. Lian stood beside Jun, looking at a chart of the final scores. Their main aim had been to make a safe, honest exhibition. The judges now announced that their team had won the community prize for its clear records, shared work, and careful treatment of visitors. The room filled with applause. For a moment Lian felt the old anger of competition rising, then watched it pass.
